items.titleEn: Go Inside Training ahead of the Community Shield
items.summaryEn: Watch our Gunners in action at the Sobha Realty Training Centre before we face Manchester City
bodyEn: We face Manchester City in the 2026/27 Community Shield on Sunday, and you can see how we've been gearing up for the clash with the latest edition of Inside Training.
After celebrating our first Premier League title in 20 years last season, we start this campaign against FA Cup and League Cup winners City at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff.
Mikel Arteta will be looking to continue his fantastic record in the competition as a player, coach and manager, having won the Community Shield on all six occasions he's competed in it.
Press play on the video at the top of the article to see what we've been up to at the Sobha Realty Training Centre before the traditional curtain raiser.

items.titleEn: Community Shield preview: Arsenal v Man City
items.summaryEn: The first silverware of the season will be handed out in Cardiff on Sunday - get the latest team news, stats, a guide to City's summer and more
bodyEn: With our historic title-winning campaign now in the rear-view mirror, 2026/27 properly gets underway on Sunday when we face Manchester City in the Community Shield (3pm UK).

Pre-season gives way to competitive action at Cardiff’s Principality Stadium. We became accustomed to the iconic home of Welsh rugby in the early 2000s, but after a 19-year wait to return, fittingly it feels like a fresh venue for our rivalry with a new-look Citizens side to enter a new chapter, after Pep Guardiola’s summer resignation.

Mikel Arteta will therefore hope to land an early blow on Enzo Maresca’s outfit, and aim to start the new season as we hope to finish it, with Martin Odegaard once again lifting silverware high into the sky amongst red and white confetti.
CITY’S NEW ERA

Guardiola’s departure has seen Maresca fill some incredibly large shoes. Like Arteta, he spent time learning under Guardiola during a spell as City’s under-21 manager in 2020/21, and has stepped back into management after his acrimonious exit from Chelsea in January.

A squad refresh has seen Bernardo Silva and John Stones find new homes at Real Madrid and Inter Milan, with the England defender followed by Manuel Akanji. James Trafford joined Leeds United, Nathan Ake is now at Fenerbahce, while Tijjani Reijnders is set for a move to Al Qadsiah. Meanwhile, speculation swirls around World Cup-winning captain Rodri's future.

To offset those losses, a record fee for an Englishman saw Elliott Anderson join from Nottingham Forest for £116 million, but he remains their only major arrival. Argentinian international goalkeeper Geronimo Rulli was signed as a backup, while Jeremy Monga (Leicester City), Mathys Detourbet (Troyes) and Pierce Charles (Sheffield Wednesday) were all captured with an eye on the future.
Pre-season has seen a patched-up side draw 1-1 with Inter Milan in Hong Kong, before beating the K League All Stars and Atletico Madrid in South Korea.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY

Arteta: "I love the way the players have come back, most of them earlier than expected, really fit with all the testing, and they all seem in great condition. The moment they start to look at each other and look at the squad that we have and what we are building, there is a lot of excitement around it.
"The best version of us has to be on Sunday, and that's the intention: that we have the best performance and the best way to start the season, by lifting the first trophy."
Maresca: “For me personally, it is a trophy. When trophies and a final are there, you always try to win the game, so, no friendly game at all. It’s a trophy that we are going to try our best to win.

“Arsenal have shown in the last five years that they have always been there. It’s a fantastic team, well managed by Mikel. Last year they won the Premier League; they showed how good they are at this moment, but at the same time, we are City and we are going to try to close the gap and try to compete again.”
TEAM NEWS

We will definitely be missing William Saliba and Jurrien Timber in Cardiff, with the Frenchman undergoing rehab on a back issue, while Jurrien is a few weeks away from fully recovering from the groin injury that forced him to miss the World Cup.
Declan Rice, Bukayo Saka and Martin Zubimendi have yet to feature during pre-season but have been training this week, and Mikel believes they're ready for some involvement.

None of City's players who reached the quarter-finals of the tournament have been exposed to any pre-season action, so it remains to be seen how much of Erling Haaland, Marc Guehi, Nico O’Reilly, Rayan Cherki, Jeremy Doku and Anderson we'll see at the Principality Stadium.

After picking up a winner's medal, Rodri will miss the game after undergoing minor back surgery following the tournament, while winger Ryan McAidoo has picked up a shoulder issue and misses out. Jack Grealish is back training with City after spending last season on loan at Everton.
TALKING TACTICS

Adrian Clarke: It will be fascinating to see what changes in Manchester City’s approach now Maresca is in charge. One of the Italian’s tactical priorities is to release his wingers for 1v1 opportunities, by morphing into a 3-2-2-3 shape in possession, playing through the middle before releasing the ball sharply to the flanks. It will help that Jeremy Doku and Antoine Semenyo are two of the best dribblers in the business.

City will remain a possession-heavy team. Anderson made more successful passes than any other Premier League midfielder in 2025/26, just ahead of the departing Bernardo Silva, while it'll also be interesting to see their inverted full-backs, and how they attempt to press high in a 4-2-4, tempting opponents to clip the ball over the first line into midfield.

Omar Marmoush has had a strong summer – along with Semenyo – while Rayan Cherki’s 12 assists last term almost mirrored Bruno Fernandes’ output (0.60 assists v 0.62 assists per 90 minutes) so he is somebody to keep close tabs on, every time the Frenchman gets onto the ball.

Looking at them in friendly action, the area we might exploit best is playing through the thirds. City will commit players to their press but if they are not in sync, we can find holes that might pick them apart.
FACTS AND STATS

Only Manchester United (21) have won the Community Shield more often than us (17, including shared), and we have won each of our last five curtain-raisers. We have also won all three matches as reigning Premier League champions (1998, 2002, 2004).
Manchester City last won the Community Shield in 2024, beating Manchester United on penalties. However, they’ve been runners-up in the match nine times, with only their neighbours doing so more (10).

On the last 10 occasions the Community Shield has been between the league champions and the FA Cup winners, the FA Cup holders have won eight times. The exceptions were both Man City, beating Chelsea in 2018 and Man Utd in 2024.
We have won all three of our Community Shield matches against Manchester City, beating them 4-0 in 1934, 3-0 in 2014 and 4-1 on penalties after a 1-1 draw in 2023.
During the period it was first used between 2001 and 2007, we played more games at the Principality Stadium than any other side (10).
This is just Manchester City’s second ever match at the Principality Stadium, with the other coming in a UEFA Cup qualifying match against TNS in August 2003 (won 2-0).
City have lost just one of their last 12 games in all competitions (W9 D2), though it was their final game of 2025/26 against Aston Villa.
Mikel Arteta won both of his Community Shield matches as a player (2014, 2015), and has won both so far as a manager (2020, 2023), with both managerial victories coming via a penalty shootout.
Enzo Maresca will be the first Man City manager whose first game in charge is in the Community Shield.
MATCH OFFICIALS

Sam Barrott has been selected to get our campaign underway in Cardiff, in what is his first major final. We have won on nine of the 10 occasions he has refereed us since our 4-3 win against Luton Town in December 2023 - the only blot being the FA Cup exit to Southampton back in April.

The Yorkshireman has never sent one of our players off, nor given a penalty against us, pointing to the spot once in our favour to allow Viktor Gyokeres to slam in from 12 yards at Everton last December. He has overseen four City wins in six appointments.
The game will be 90 minutes, with no extra time. If the score is level at full time, a penalty shootout will determine the winner.
Referee: Sam BarrottAssistants: Craig Taylor, Blake AntrobusFourth official: Farai HallamVAR: James Bell
PREVIOUS SHIELD SUCCESSES

On the last five occasions we have contested the Community Shield, we have lifted the trophy. The run began in 2014 when we defeated City 3-0 when Arteta collected the trophy as captain, and we retained it 12 months later when Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain’s goal beat Chelsea.

We’ve required penalties to win the subsequent three finals, overcoming the Blues once again in 2017 after a 1-1 draw, and did the same against Liverpool three years later. Another 1-1 scoreline was recorded in 2023 when Leandro Trossard left it late to equalise against City, whom we overcame on spot-kicks.
This will be our fifth Community Shield match at the Principality Stadium, winning in 2002 against Liverpool thanks to a Gilberto Silva goal, and two years later overcoming Manchester United 3-1.

items.titleZh: 社区盾前瞻：阿森纳对阵曼城
items.summaryZh: 本赛季首座奖杯周日于加的夫颁发，速览最新球队新闻、数据及曼城夏季动态。
bodyZh: 随着我们历史性的夺冠征程已成为过去，2026/27赛季于周日正式开启，届时我们将在社区盾中对阵曼城（英国时间下午3点）。
季前备战让位于加的夫公国球场的正式比赛。我们在2000年代初就习惯了威尔士橄榄球的标志性主场，但在等待19年后重返这里，恰逢瓜迪奥拉今夏离任，我们与焕然一新的曼城队的对决似乎迎来了新篇章。
因此，米克尔·阿尔特塔希望给恩佐·马雷斯卡的球队一个下马威，并目标以我们希望结束新赛季的方式开局——由马丁·厄德高在红白纸屑中再次高举奖杯。
曼城新时代
瓜迪奥拉的离任让马雷斯卡接过了重担。和阿尔特塔一样，他曾在2020/21赛季担任曼城U21主教练期间师从瓜迪奥拉，并在今年1月不愉快地离开切尔西后重返教练席。
球队阵容更新，贝尔纳多·席尔瓦和约翰·斯通斯分别加盟皇家马德里和国际米兰，英格兰后卫之后曼努埃尔·阿坎吉也离队。詹姆斯·特拉福德加盟利兹联，纳坦·阿克现效力于费内巴切，而蒂贾尼·赖因德斯即将转会至卡迪西亚。与此同时，关于世界杯冠军队长罗德里未来的猜测不断。
为了弥补这些损失，埃利奥特·安德森以创英格兰球员纪录的1.16亿英镑从诺丁汉森林加盟，但他仍是球队唯一的重要引援。阿根廷国门赫罗尼莫·鲁利作为替补签约，而杰里米·蒙加（莱斯特城）、马蒂斯·德图尔贝（特鲁瓦）和皮尔斯·查尔斯（谢菲尔德星期三）都是着眼于未来而签下的。
季前赛中，一支拼凑阵容的球队在香港1-1战平国际米兰，随后在韩国击败了K联赛全明星队和马德里竞技。
教练言论
阿尔特塔：“我喜欢球员们回归的方式，大多数人比预期更早归队，所有测试都表明他们状态极佳。当他们开始相互审视，审视我们现有的阵容以及我们正在构建的蓝图时，周围充满了兴奋之情。”
“周日我们必须展现出最好的自己，这就是我们的意图：拿出最佳表现，以举起第一座奖杯的方式开启新赛季。”
马雷斯卡：“对我个人而言，这是一座奖杯。当有奖杯和决赛时，你总是试图赢得比赛，所以这绝非友谊赛。我们会尽全力赢得这座奖杯。”
“阿森纳在过去五年中证明了他们始终保持着竞争力。这是一支出色的球队，由米克尔很好地管理。去年他们赢得了英超冠军；他们展现了目前有多出色，但与此同时，我们是曼城，我们将努力缩小差距并再次竞争。”
球队新闻
我们将确定在加的夫缺少威廉·萨利巴和尤里恩·廷贝尔，法国人正在治疗背部问题，而尤里恩距离从腹股沟伤势中完全康复还需要几周时间，该伤势也使他错过了世界杯。
德克兰·赖斯、布卡约·萨卡和马丁·苏比门迪在季前赛中尚未出场，但本周一直在训练，米克尔认为他们已经准备好参与部分比赛。
曼城进入赛事四分之一决赛的球员都没有参加任何季前赛，因此厄林·哈兰德、马克·格伊、尼科·奥赖利、拉扬·谢尔基、杰里米·多库和安德森在公国球场的出场时间还有待观察。
在随队夺得冠军奖牌后，罗德里因赛事后接受了轻微的背部手术将缺席本场比赛，而边锋瑞安·麦卡伊杜则因肩伤缺席。杰克·格拉利什在上赛季租借至埃弗顿后已回归曼城训练。
战术讨论
阿德里安·克拉克：马雷斯卡接手后，曼城的打法会有何变化，这令人着迷。这位意大利人的战术重点之一是解放边锋，创造一对一机会。他在控球时采用3-2-2-3阵型，通过中路推进，然后将球迅速分到边路。杰里米·多库和安托万·塞梅尼奥都是当今足坛最出色的盘带手，这将有所帮助。
曼城仍将是一支控球为主的球队。2025/26赛季，安德森的成功传球次数冠绝英超中场，领先于即将离队的贝尔纳多·席尔瓦。此外，他们的内收边后卫以及如何在4-2-4阵型中高位逼抢，诱使对手将球越过第一道防线送入中场，也值得关注。
奥马尔·马尔穆什与塞梅尼奥一样，度过了一个强势的夏天。而拉扬·谢尔基上赛季的12次助攻几乎与布鲁诺·费尔南德斯的产出相当（每90分钟0.60次助攻对0.62次），所以每次这位法国人拿球时，都需要对他严加盯防。
从他们的友谊赛表现来看，我们最可以利用的领域是通过三线之间的传递。曼城会投入球员进行逼抢，但如果他们不同步，我们就能找到撕开他们防线的空当。
事实与数据
只有曼联（21次）赢得社区盾的次数比我们（17次，包括共享）更多，而且我们赢得了过去五次赛季揭幕战。作为卫冕英超冠军，我们也赢得了全部三场比赛（1998、2002、2004）。
曼城上一次赢得社区盾是在2024年，当时他们在点球大战中击败曼联。然而，他们曾九次在该赛事中获得亚军，只有他们的邻居（曼联）更多（10次）。
在过去10次社区盾由联赛冠军对阵足总杯冠军的交手中，足总杯冠军赢了8次。例外均是曼城，他们在2018年击败切尔西和2024年击败曼联。
我们在社区盾中对阵曼城的三场比赛全部获胜，分别是1934年4-0，2014年3-0，以及2023年1-1战平后点球大战4-1取胜。
在2001年至2007年首次使用该球场期间，我们在公国球场比赛的次数（10场）比任何其他球队都多。
这只是曼城在公国球场的第二场比赛，此前一场是2003年8月欧洲联盟杯资格赛对阵TNS（2-0获胜）。
曼城在过去12场各项赛事中仅输一场（9胜2平），不过那场失利是2025/26赛季末对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛。
米克尔·阿尔特塔作为球员赢得了两场社区盾比赛（2014、2015），作为教练迄今为止也赢了两场（2020、2023），而且两场教练胜利均通过点球大战获胜。
恩佐·马雷斯卡将成为首位执教首秀即社区盾的曼城教练。
比赛官员
萨姆·巴罗特被任命执法我们在加的夫的这场比赛，这也是他执法的首场重大决赛。自2023年12月我们4-3战胜卢顿以来，在他执法的10场比赛中我们赢了9场——唯一的瑕疵是4月份足总杯被南安普顿淘汰。
这位约克郡人从未罚下过我们的球员，也没有判给我们点球，不过曾在去年12月对埃弗顿的比赛中判给我们一粒点球，让维克托·哲凯赖什从12码处劲射入网。他在执法的6场比赛中见证了曼城4次获胜。
比赛为90分钟，无加时赛。如果全场比分持平，将进行点球大战决出胜负。
主裁判：萨姆·巴罗特；助理裁判：克雷格·泰勒、布莱克·安特罗布斯；第四官员：法拉伊·哈勒姆；VAR：詹姆斯·贝尔。
过往社区盾战绩
过去五次我们参加社区盾均捧起奖杯。这一纪录始于2014年，当时我们3-0战胜曼城，阿尔特塔作为队长举起奖杯；12个月后，我们凭借亚历克斯·张伯伦的进球击败切尔西成功卫冕。
随后的三次决赛我们均通过点球获胜，2017年在1-1战平后再次击败蓝军（切尔西），三年后对阵利物浦如法炮制。2023年我们再次录得1-1，莱安德罗·特罗萨德在最后时刻扳平曼城，随后我们在点球大战中击败了他们。
这将是我们第五次在公国球场参加社区盾，2002年凭借吉尔伯托·席尔瓦的进球战胜利物浦，两年后3-1战胜曼联。

items.titleEn: Principality Perfection: Our best wins in Cardiff
items.summaryEn: We take a look back at some of the classic victories in Cardiff down the years
bodyEn: After almost 20 years, we're returning to the Principality Stadium as we take on Manchester City in the Community Shield.
The ground became a home away from home for Arsene Wenger's side, winning the FA Cup on three occasions as well as picking up two Community Shields.
As we get set to make our return, here's a look at some of our classic victories in Cardiff!
PARLOUR'S PEARLER
Arsenal 2-0 Chelsea - FA Cup final, May 2002
We headed to Cardiff in May 2002 to take on Chelsea in the FA Cup final as we looked to complete part one of a historic double.

After a tight first half, we broke the deadlock with 20 minutes to play with one of the all-time classic FA Cup final goals. Midfielder Ray Parlour picked the ball up in space and unleashed a shot beyond Carlo Cudicini and into the top corner.
The game was sealed 10 minutes later with another belter, this time from Freddie Ljungberg, curling into the net. Four days later, we won the Premier League to clinch our second double.
PIRES WINS THE CUP
Arsenal 1-0 Southampton - FA Cup final, May 2003
A year on from our Chelsea triumph, we were back in Cardiff looking to defend the trophy against Southampton.
With the roof on at the Principality Stadium, Robert Pires scored the game's decisive goal to help us to back-to-back.
The game was David Seaman's last as a Gunner, bringing an end to his momentous 13-year spell in north London.
PENALTY DRAMA
Arsenal (5-4 pens) 0-0 Manchester United - FA Cup final, May 2005
Having missed out on the FA Cup in 2004, we returned to Cardiff in 2005 to take on holders Manchester United.
In a display of resilience, we stood firm against the Red Devils' attack as the game went to extra time, where we were reduced to 10 players after Jose Antonio Reyes was shown a second yellow.
We forced the game to penalties, where Jens Lehmann denied Paul Scholes, allowing Patrick Vieira to fire home his spot kick to seal the title.
REYES BEATS REDS
Arsenal 3-1 Manchester United - Community Shield, August 2004
After completing our Invincibles campaign, our first game of the new season saw us up against Manchester United in the Community Shield curtain-raiser in Cardiff.
Having scored the winner in the 2002 edition, Gilberto opened the scoring before Alan Smith equalised for Sir Alex Ferguson's men.

Jose Antonio Reyes delivered a player of the match performance in the Welsh capital, finding the net to make it 2-1 before Ashley Cole's pass was deflected into his own net by Mikael Silvestre to give us the perfect start to 2024/05.
RVP AT THE DOUBLE
Arsenal 3-0 Blackburn Rovers, FA Cup semi-final, April 2005
The 2005 FA Cup semi-finals were hosted at the Principality Stadium for the first and only time, as we took on Blackburn Rovers for a chance to reach the final.
We broke the deadlock three minutes before half-time after good work from Kolo Toure found Pires to put us ahead.
Robin van Persie then stole the show, scoring a fine individual goal before his curling effort went beyond Brad Freidel to give us a 3-0 win and set up a final with Manchester United.

items.titleZh: 公国完美：我们在卡迪夫的经典胜利
items.summaryZh: 我们回顾多年来在卡迪夫的一些经典胜利。
bodyZh: 时隔近20年，我们将在社区盾杯中重返公国球场，对阵曼城。
这座球场几乎成了温格球队的第二主场，他们曾三次夺得足总杯，并两次捧起社区盾。
在我们即将重返之际，让我们回顾一些在卡迪夫的经典胜利！
帕洛尔的绝妙进球
阿森纳2-0切尔西 - 2002年5月足总杯决赛
2002年5月，我们前往卡迪夫，在足总杯决赛中对阵切尔西，目标是完成历史性双冠王的第一步。
上半场双方战平，第20分钟，我们凭借一粒足总杯决赛历史上的经典进球打破僵局。中场球员雷·帕洛尔在空当处接球，一脚射门越过卡罗·库迪奇尼，直挂死角。
10分钟后，另一粒精彩进球锁定了胜局，这次是弗雷迪·永贝里的弧线球入网。四天后，我们赢得英超冠军，完成了我们的第二次双冠王。
皮雷斯捧起奖杯
阿森纳1-0南安普顿 - 2003年5月足总杯决赛
在战胜切尔西一年后，我们重返卡迪夫，对阵南安普顿，卫冕奖杯。
在公国球场关顶的情况下，罗伯特·皮雷斯打入了比赛的决定性进球，帮助我们实现了卫冕。
这场比赛是大卫·希曼作为枪手的最后一场比赛，结束了他长达13年的北伦敦生涯。
点球大战
阿森纳（5-4点球）0-0曼联 - 2005年5月足总杯决赛
在2004年无缘足总杯之后，我们于2005年重返卡迪夫，对阵卫冕冠军曼联。
我们展现出了顽强的韧性，在红魔的进攻面前坚守阵地，比赛进入加时赛，而我们在何塞·安东尼奥·雷耶斯吃到第二张黄牌后被罚下，只剩下10人应战。
我们顽强地将比赛拖入点球大战，延斯·莱曼扑出了保罗·斯科尔斯的点球，随后帕特里克·维埃拉主罚命中，锁定冠军。
雷耶斯击败红魔
阿森纳3-1曼联 - 2004年8月社区盾
在完成不败赛季之后，我们新赛季的首场比赛是在卡迪夫举行的社区盾揭幕战中对阵曼联。
在2002年的比赛中打入制胜球的吉尔伯托首开纪录，随后阿兰·史密斯为弗格森爵士的球队扳平比分。
何塞·安东尼奥·雷耶斯在威尔士首都奉献了全场最佳表现，他打入一球将比分改写为2-1，随后阿什利·科尔的传球被米卡埃尔·西尔维斯特乌龙挡入自家球门，为我们开启了2024-05赛季的完美开局（注：原文为2004/05，此处照译）。
范佩西梅开二度
阿森纳3-0布莱克本流浪者 - 2005年4月足总杯半决赛
2005年足总杯半决赛首次也是唯一一次在公国球场举行，我们与布莱克本流浪者队争夺决赛资格。
半场结束前三分钟，科洛·图雷的精妙配合找到了皮雷斯，后者为我们取得领先，打破了僵局。
随后罗宾·范佩西大放异彩，他先是一记精彩的个人进球，随后一记弧线球越过布拉德·弗里德尔，为我们带来3-0的胜利，并确保与曼联会师决赛。

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has said he is relaxed about his Arsenal contract expiring at the end of the new season and believes his side will need to be better than last year to defend their title successfully.

The Premier League champions will face Enzo Maresca’s Manchester City in the Community Shield in Cardiff on Sunday and are heavy favourites to win back-to-back league titles for the first time since the 1930s. The departure of Pep Guardiola from their traditional rivals City means Arteta is now the Premier League’s longest-serving manager, with the Spaniard having joined in December 2019.

He signed a three-year contract extension in September 2024 after Arsenal finished as runners-up to City and had been expected to agree a new deal over the summer that would make him one of the highest-paid managers in the world. Arteta acknowledged on Friday that his priorities have been elsewhere this summer as he attempts to strengthen his squad before the new season but reassured supporters that he is fully committed to the club.

“They don’t have to worry about any of that, because I want to be here. I am extremely happy. I feel very grateful to work with the people that I work with and when we have the possibility, we will resolve that. And that’s it,” he said.

Asked if he expects talks over a new contract to continue after the transfer window, Arteta added: “There is always another priority, I think. And that’s the way we have been treating it, I think because everybody feels comfortable that the time on the contract is not going to be an issue. I think because my will, certainly, is to be here and I am very happy here. My feeling from the club is the same one. That is why everyone is doing things in a really organic way.”

Arsenal have opened negotiations with Bayer Leverkusen over a move for Jarell Quansah as they seek cover for William Saliba and Jurriën Timber, while they are still in the market for another attacker if they can offload Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus. After missing out on Vinícius Júnior when the Brazil forward opted to sign a new deal with Real Madrid, Arteta defended Arsenal’s strategy this summer and is hoping that they can still add to their squad.

“I am really happy with the squad, the players that I have and I am really happy with the ambition of the club. There is zero question about that. We have shown that in the manner we have tried to act,” he said.

“But I think we need to do it our own way. We have super strengths and we have other areas we need to be very conscious [of] because we don’t have the elements or the structure that other clubs have. We need to do it our way. We are always on it that way and we will do what we believe is the right thing to do. To have the best possibility to compete in every competition that’s for sure.”

items.titleZh: “不会成为问题”：阿尔特塔对阿森纳合同情况感到放松
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔表示对合同到期感到放松，并称球队需比去年更出色。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔表示，他对自己的阿森纳合同将在新赛季结束后到期感到放松，并认为球队需要比去年表现得更好才能成功卫冕冠军。
英超冠军将在周日的社区盾杯中于加的夫对阵恩佐·马雷斯卡执教的曼城，并且是自20世纪30年代以来首次连续夺得联赛冠军的热门球队。佩普·瓜迪奥拉离开传统对手曼城，意味着阿尔特塔现在是英超执教时间最长的主教练，这位西班牙人于2019年12月加盟。
他在2024年9月签署了一份为期三年的续约合同，此前阿森纳在联赛中排名第二，落后于曼城，而外界预计他将在夏季达成新协议，使他成为世界上薪酬最高的主教练之一。阿尔特塔在周五承认，这个夏天他的优先事项放在了其他地方，因为他试图在新赛季前增强阵容，但他向支持者保证，他对俱乐部完全投入。
“他们不必为此担心，因为我想留在这里。我非常开心。我非常感激能与我共事的人一起工作，当我们有机会时，我们会解决这个问题。就这样，”他说。
在被问及是否预计转会窗口结束后会继续就新合同进行谈判时，阿尔特塔补充道：“我认为总有另一个优先事项。我们一直是这么对待的，因为大家都觉得合同时间不会成为问题。当然，因为我的意愿是留在这里，而且我在这里非常开心。俱乐部给我的感觉也是一样的。这就是为什么每个人都在以非常自然的方式做事。”
阿森纳已与勒沃库森就雅雷尔·昆萨的转会展开谈判，以寻求威廉·萨利巴和尤里安·廷贝尔的替补，同时他们仍在市场上寻找另一名攻击手，前提是能出售加布里埃尔·马丁内利和加布里埃尔·热苏斯。在维尼修斯·儒尼奥尔选择与皇家马德里续约而错失他之后，阿尔特塔为阿森纳今年夏天的策略进行了辩护，并希望他们仍能补充阵容。
“我对阵容、现有的球员以及俱乐部的雄心感到非常满意。这一点毫无疑问。我们已经通过我们的行动方式表明了这一点，”他说。
“但我认为我们需要用自己的方式做事。我们有超强的优势，也有其他领域需要非常谨慎，因为我们没有其他俱乐部所拥有的要素或结构。我们需要走自己的路。我们一直在这样做，我们会做我们认为正确的事情。为了在每个赛事中都有最好的竞争机会，这一点是肯定的。”

items.titleEn: Arteta: Players hungry for Community Shield success
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta has spoken about the hunger in the camp to try and win the Community Shield
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has seen the hunger within his team as we go all out to win the Community Shield against Manchester City.
We head to the Principality Stadium for the first trophy of the season, going up against the FA Cup winners.
Speaking at his pre-match press conference, Mikel is delighted with the way his players have returned to training and is confident the energy is high in the camp.

"We are really excited to start the season," Mikel said. "To start with the first trophy as well, I sense a really good energy around the place. All the internationals are back, and we can’t wait to start competing.
"It’s a trophy that we can have because we managed last year to win the Premier League, and you can tell how hungry the players are, which is a good sign.

"I said it the other day, I love the way the players have come back, most of them earlier than expected, really fit with all the testing and they all seem in great condition. The moment they start to look at each other and look at the squad that we have and what we are building, there is a lot of excitement around it."
It's the first time we'll go up against Manchester City without Pep Guardiola in charge since 2016.
Enzo Maresca will take charge of his first competitive match in Cardiff, and Mikel gave his thoughts on facing a new-look City.
"I know Enzo has the character and especially the knowledge to do an unbelievable job there," he said.

"That’s why he has been selected, because they can probably pick anybody, and they’ve gone for Enzo for the right reasons. He has demonstrated at every level, when he’s gone to the Champions League, what he’s done at Chelsea and now at City. I’m sure he’ll do a great job."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔：球员们渴望社区盾胜利
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈球队渴望社区盾夺冠。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔看到了球队内部的渴望，我们将全力以赴对阵曼城赢得社区盾。
我们将前往公国体育场争夺本赛季首个奖杯，对手是足总杯冠军。
在赛前新闻发布会上，米克尔对球员们回归训练的方式感到满意，并相信球队士气高涨。
“我们真的很期待开始新赛季，”米克尔说。“以第一个奖杯开始，我感受到周围有很好的能量。所有国际球员都回来了，我们迫不及待地想开始竞争。”
“这是一个我们可以获得的奖杯，因为我们上赛季赢得了英超冠军，你可以看出球员们有多渴望，这是一个好兆头。”
“我前几天说过，我喜欢球员们回归的方式，大多数人比预期更早，在各项测试中都非常健康，看起来状态很好。当他们开始互相审视、看待我们拥有的阵容以及正在建设的东西时，会有很多兴奋。”
这是自2016年以来，我们首次对阵没有佩普·瓜迪奥拉执教的曼城。
恩佐·马雷斯卡将在卡迪夫迎来他的首场正式比赛，米克尔谈到了对阵新面貌的曼城的看法。
“我知道恩佐有性格，尤其是有知识去那里做出不可思议的工作，”他说。
“这就是他被选中的原因，因为他们可能会挑选任何人，而他们选择恩佐是出于正确的理由。他在各个层面都展示了，当他进入欧冠时，他在切尔西所做的，现在在曼城。我相信他会做得很好。”

items.titleEn: Arteta's update on Rice, Saka, Saliba and Timber
items.summaryEn: The boss gave an updated on our international stars ahead of the Community Shield
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has issued the first fitness update of the new season as we prepare to face Manchester City at the Millennium Stadium in the Community Shield on Sunday (3pm UK).
Less than a month after the World Cup final, we'll be back in domestic action with the traditional curtain raiser against the FA Cup champions, having won the Premier League title ourselves.
Despite the short turnaround from international duty for several players, the boss remarked how impressed he's been with the overall fitness of our squad this week.

"I love the way the players have come back," the boss said on Friday at the Sobha Realty Training Centre, "most of them [came back] earlier than expected, really fit with all the testing and they all seem in great condition.
"The moment they start to look at each other and look at the squad that we have and what we are building, there is a lot of excitement around it."
Since returning from international duty, three members of our squad, Bukayo Saka, Declan Rice and Martin Zubimendi are yet to feature in a match, sitting out our pre-season fixtures.
But Mikel feels all three players could be involved against City on Sunday having returned to training earlier this week.
"They will be available, they trained with us today, they will train tomorrow and if they are in the condition that we expect them to be, they will be involved."
Asked whether any fitness issues could restrict Bukayo or Declan's minutes in the early part of the season, the boss reported that he hadn't seen anything to raise concern.
"We haven't noticed anything; they had individual plans through the time that they had with the national team. They've been trying to evolve those issues and they have improved.
"In the rest period that they had, they both had specific programmes for themselves. They've been doing those and so far, what I saw the last two or three days, it was really good."
While Bukayo and Declan are hoping to be ready for the start of the new season, Sunday will come too soon for defensive duo Jurrien Timber and William Saliba.
Both players suffered injuries over the summer, but are hard at work as they look to make their way back into the squad.
"Jurrien is progressing really well," Mikel reported, "he is on the pitch, we are ramping up now with certain actions and especially the volume and the load.
"I think he is on a good trajectory, but there is still a few weeks to go. Wilo, as we all know, it's more a long-term injury."
Pressed on a recovery timeline, Mikel didn't suggest a return date either player, but hinted that Jurrien is nearing a return to training with the rest of our squad.
"We have to wait and see. He needs to start to train with the group in the next week or so hopefully, and then see how he progresses from there.
"It's been a long-term issue, and we want to make sure that every step that we take is the right one, he feels right to do that, because he's such an important player for us."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔更新赖斯、萨卡、萨利巴和廷贝尔的情况
items.summaryZh: 主帅在社区盾前更新了国际球员的情况。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔发布了新赛季的首次伤情更新，我们将在周日的社区盾杯中于千禧球场对阵曼城（英国时间下午3点）。
距离世界杯决赛结束不到一个月，我们将迎来国内赛事回归，按传统对阵足总杯冠军，而我们是英超冠军。
尽管多名球员从国家队归来后休息时间短暂，主帅表示本周他对全队的整体状态印象深刻。
主帅周五在索巴房地产训练中心表示：“我喜欢球员们归队的方式，大多数人比预期更早归队，所有测试显示他们非常健康，看起来状态都很好。”
“当他们开始互相观察，看看我们现有的阵容以及正在构建的一切，大家都对此充满兴奋。”
自国际比赛任务归来后，布卡约·萨卡、德克兰·赖斯和马丁·祖比门迪这三名队员尚未在任何比赛中出场，他们缺席了季前赛。
但米克尔认为这三人都有可能在周日对阵曼城的比赛中出场，因为他们已于本周早些时候恢复训练。
“他们可以出场，今天和我们一起训练了，明天还会继续，如果他们的状态达到我们的预期，他们就会上场。”
当被问及是否有任何伤情问题会限制布卡约或德克兰在赛季初期的出场时间时，主帅表示他没有看到任何令人担忧的情况。
“我们没有注意到任何问题；他们在国家队期间有个人的计划，一直在试图解决这些问题，并且已经有所改善。”
“在他们休息期间，两人都有专门的训练计划。他们一直在执行，就我最近两三天看到的而言，情况非常好。”
尽管布卡约和德克兰希望能为新赛季做好准备，但对于防守组合尤里安·廷贝尔和威廉·萨利巴来说，周日来得太快了。
两名球员都在夏天受伤，但他们正在努力训练，争取重返球队。
米克尔报告说：“尤里安进展非常好，他已经开始上球场，我们现在正在增加某些动作的训练，特别是训练量和负荷。”
“我认为他走在正确的轨道上，但还需要几个星期。至于威洛，我们都知道，这是一次更长期的伤病。”
在被追问恢复时间表时，米克尔没有透露任何球员的回归日期，但暗示尤里安已接近恢复与全队合练。
“我们必须等待观察。希望他能在下周左右开始与球队一起训练，然后再看看进展如何。”
“这是一个长期问题，我们希望确保每一步都走得正确，他感觉合适再行动，因为他对我们来说是非常重要的球员。”

items.titleEn: Every word from Arteta's pre-Community Shield presser
items.summaryEn: Read every word from Mikel Arteta before we face Manchester City
bodyEn: For the first time this season, Mikel Arteta spoke to the press as we get set to take on Manchester City in the Community Shield.
We head to the Principality Stadium in Cardiff for the first time since 2007 as we look to clinch the first trophy of the season.
Mikel gave an update on the squad's fitness ahead of Enzo Maresca's Manchester City and much more. Here's everything he said below:
on Saka, Rice and Zubimendi:They will be available; they trained with us today, they will train tomorrow, and if they are in the condition we expect them to be in, they will be involved.

on Timber and Saliba:Jurrien is progressing really well, he is on the pitch. We are ramping up now with certain actions and especially the volume and the load, and I think he is on a good trajectory, but there are still a few weeks to go. Wilo, as we all know, it’s more a long-term injury.

on if Timber will be fit before the international break:I don’t know; we have to wait and see. He needs to start training with the group in the next week or so, hopefully, and then see how he progresses from there. It’s been a long-term issue right now, and we want to make sure that every step that we take is the right one, he feels right to do that and he’s such an important player for us.

on the transfer window:It’s a very exciting part of the season, when a lot of things happen. I think you create excitement; there’s an opportunity as well to evolve. There's also a good way to understand what every player is feeling. We are trying the maximum that we can to end up in 14 days, 13 days in the best possible condition to compete for every possible competition.
on if players are coming out as well as coming in:It’s always the case; there’s an opportunity there to go both ways, and we’ll have to see how the market responds and what we as a club can do.

on links to Quansah and Konsa:I’m not going to talk about any individuals obviously. What I can tell you is the ambition of the club, it's big, we want to improve the squad, we want to evolve the squad, and in order to achieve that, we have obviously detected some areas that can be strengthened. That’s what we are trying to do.

on aiming to win the Community Shield:That’s what we’re going to try to do, we’re going to have a really strong opponent, but we are really excited to start the season, to start with the first trophy as well. I sense a really good energy around the place; all the internationals are back, and we can’t wait to start competing.
on the players seeing this as a big game:It’s a trophy that we can have because we managed last year to win the Premier League, and you can tell how hungry the players are, which is a good sign.

on if the game is a marker for the season:That’s what we want, and adapting to the circumstances and the kind of preparation that we have. But I said it the other day, I love the way the players have come back, most of them earlier than expected, really fit with all the testing, and they all seem in great condition. The moment they start to look at each other and look at the squad that we have and what we are building, there is a lot of excitement around it.

on when we will see the best version of his team:The best version has to be on Sunday, and that's the intention: that we have the best performance and the best way to start the season by lifting the first trophy. That's the way we have prepared the season - from day one, to be at our maximum level because that's the standard for us.

on if we have to sell players:We have certain possibilities that we can explore if the right possibilities come across. But so far, with the numbers we have, we are happy; obviously, we need to accept that certain players will probably have to move.

on Rice and Saka managing any fitness issues:We haven't noticed anything. They have individual plans from their time with the national team. They've been trying to evolve those issues and they have improved. In the rest period that they had, they both had specific programmes for themselves. They've been doing those and so far, what I saw the last two or three days, it was really good.

on his plans for Ethan Nwaneri this season:I don't know the plans, but certainly he opens your eyes in terms of how much a young player can evolve in such a short period. Work and experience abroad come with certain difficulties and challenges - what you can really get out of that, and I think he's done it in a brilliant way. It's unquestionable the talent, the desire, the love and the passion he has for the game. It's something that I always loved about Ethan. I think he had some great games and he's shown everybody that he has the ability to be here.

on if he wants Ethan to be at the club this season:I want him to be at the club, but in the middle, long term, what is best for the player? Ethan needs to play football, and if he stays here, it’s because we can guarantee that he can have those minutes. Otherwise, it's just something that is not good for anybody, I think.

on the expectation of Martin Odegaard this season:With him and Bukayo as well, I see something else. Obviously they had some issues last year and they couldn't have the consistency levels that they know they can bring to the team. So there is a big margin and a big gap there that I think the team is going to benefit from because I can see the desire in them.

on if it's surprised him to see players sold for over £100m:Yes, it has. I wouldn't have bet on that to be fair. But that’s the market, that means that there are clubs that are happy to invest or they believe that the valuations of those players are that, and that's fair. In the end, the value of the player is what somebody can pay for you, and they've done it, so that's the value and it's the right one because someone is happy to sell and someone is happy to buy, and in the middle, a player is happy to move from one club to the other. So I think that's fair.

on how football will evolve this season:Last year we saw the tie between PSG and Bayern Munich, something we probably haven't witnessed before. So let's see. The World Cup brought some very different stuff. I think it's very different, international football, to anything related to the Premier League, but we'll wait and see. I'm sure there will be surprises and everybody will have to adapt quickly to certain changes. I think the rules will be different as well, and when the rules change, everything changes and the game evolves. So we'll see a change there as well.

on if there will be an evolution in his team:There is room there for sure, with the players that we have ourselves. I think elevating the quality we have, and elevating individual performance, has to be the main focus. If we cannot do that for whatever reason, then we have to think about recruiting.

on Pep Guardiola departing Manchester City:I’m probably going to fall short in the way I can praise what he’s done. First of all for the Premier League, for the country, the way he has opened a different way of understanding the game, and I think he has escalated the Premier League to a different level. He has brought standards to something that we haven’t witnessed before; I was very lucky to be part of it for four years and to understand and witness how it’s done daily. It’s remarkable, it’s unique, and I’ve always said before that I think he’s the best coach in the history of football for many reasons.

He’s done it in many different countries and leagues, but in a really consistent and sustainable way, which is the hardest thing to do. I think he’s going to be missed in the Premier League - I don’t know if as coaches we’ll miss him so much! It’s so difficult to play against him and to compete in the manner that he does with his teams. First of all, I have gratitude for the time I have had with him, which was incredible and then because I think he's elevated all the coaches and teams to work in different ways, and he’s made all of us better. He’s been a pleasure, and now it’s Enzo [Maresca], who is as good as him because I know him well. He’ll provide something different to the club and I wish him the best.

on if he knew Guardiola might leave before it was announced:100% not, but I had some feeling and some understanding that this could be. You could sense it in the last year that there could have been a situation of it happening, but with someone like him, he could wake up in the morning and be so excited about what he sees around him and carry on doing it - as he has done for 10 years, which nowadays is something just incredible.

on how special it was to win the league while Guardiola was still here:It’s obviously one of the biggest challenges I have faced in my career, because I know the standards. They had the backroom, the stability, the quality to go and do it again, so it’s been a real challenge, but as I said, I took it in a way that regardless of what happened, this would make us better and push boundaries time after time in every department of the club, to try and reach this level. When I arrived here, I had a sense, in terms of distance and years, of how far we were behind, because I was there to witness the daily operation and the level to be able to win it. To do it in the time that we’ve done it, I think we should feel proud.

on the role Max Dowman will have this season:He’s 100% with us, that’s for sure - he’s done the pre-season, and he’s in our system in every effect. How much he’ll play is like anyone else, he needs to earn it. If he earns it, he will play; if somebody else earns it, he won’t play that much.

on Myles Lewis-Skelly's role within the squad:It depends what happens with the squad, how he trains and the position. There are a lot of players that can play in various positions, and this is a huge quality we have in the squad.

on Maresca following on from Guardiola:I don’t know the intricacies, but I know Enzo has the character and especially the knowledge to do an unbelievable job there. That’s why he has been selected, because they can probably pick anybody, and they’ve gone for Enzo for the right reasons. He has demonstrated at every level, when he’s gone to the Champions League, what he’s done at Chelsea and now at City. I’m sure he’ll do a great job.

on if he's happy with the level of his side:I think we’re in a really good place, doing some really good things, and we’re still adapting. We have a few days towards the first trophy, and then the Premier League is going to start a few days later, and I think we haven’t compromised anything; we’ve taken every situation with a lot of naturalness to get the team in the best possible condition.

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔赛前新闻发布会完整发言
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔谈球队伤病、转会及对阵曼城的准备。
bodyZh: 本赛季首次，米克尔·阿尔特塔在社区盾对阵曼城前接受了媒体采访。
我们自2007年以来首次前往卡迪夫的公国球场，希望夺得本赛季首座奖杯。
米克尔更新了球队的伤病情况，谈到了恩佐·马雷斯卡执教的曼城，以及其他话题。以下是他的全部发言：
关于萨卡、赖斯和祖比门迪：他们都可以出场；他们今天随队训练，明天也会训练，如果他们的状态达到我们的预期，他们就会参赛。
关于廷贝尔和萨利巴：尤里安（廷贝尔）恢复得很好，他已经在场上训练了。我们现在正在增加某些动作，尤其是训练量和负荷，我认为他走在正确的轨道上，但还需要几周时间。威洛（萨利巴）众所周知，这是一个更长期的伤病。
关于廷贝尔是否能在国际比赛日前复出：我不知道，我们只能等待。他需要在下周左右开始随队训练，希望如此，然后再看他如何进步。目前这是一个长期问题，我们希望确保每一步都走对，他感觉良好，他对我们非常重要。
关于转会窗口：这是赛季中非常激动人心的部分，很多事情会发生。我认为你会制造兴奋感，这也是进化的机会。这也是了解每个球员感受的好方法。我们正尽最大努力，争取在14天或13天后以最佳状态结束（转会窗），以便为每一项可能的比赛而战。
关于是否有球员进出：总是如此，有双向的机会，我们必须看看市场的反应以及我们俱乐部能做什么。
关于与奎安萨和孔萨的传闻：我显然不会谈论任何个人。我能告诉你的是俱乐部的雄心，很大，我们希望提升球队，发展球队，为了实现这一目标，我们显然已经发现了一些可以加强的领域。这就是我们正在努力做的。
关于目标赢得社区盾：这就是我们要努力做到的，我们将面对一个非常强大的对手，但我们非常兴奋能开始新赛季，并且以第一座奖杯开始。我感觉到这里充满了良好的能量；所有国脚都回来了，我们迫不及待地开始竞争。
关于球员们是否将此视为一场重要比赛：这是我们能赢得的奖杯，因为去年我们赢得了英超，你能看出球员们有多么渴望，这是一个好迹象。
关于这场比赛是否是赛季的风向标：这是我们想要的，并且适应环境和我们所做的准备。但我前几天说过，我喜欢球员们回归的方式，大多数人比预期提前回来，在测试中非常健康，他们看起来状态都很好。当他们开始互相注视、审视我们所拥有的阵容以及正在建设的东西时，周围充满了兴奋。
关于何时能看到最佳状态的球队：最佳状态必须出现在周日，这就是我们的意图：打出最佳表现，以举起第一座奖杯的方式开始赛季。这就是我们备战赛季的方式——从第一天起，就要达到最高水平，因为这是我们的标准。
关于我们是否必须出售球员：如果合适的机会出现，我们有一些可能性可以探索。但到目前为止，我们对我们现有的人员数量感到满意；显然，我们需要接受某些球员可能会离队。
关于赖斯和萨卡是否有伤病问题：我们没有注意到任何问题。他们在国家队期间有个人的计划。他们一直在努力解决这些问题并且有所改善。在休息期间，他们都有具体的计划。他们一直在执行，到目前为止，我最近两三天看到的情况非常好。
关于伊桑·恩瓦内里本赛季的计划：我不知道具体计划，但毫无疑问，他让你看到一名年轻球员能在这么短的时间内取得多大进步。在国外工作和经历会带来一定的困难和挑战——你能从中真正得到什么？我认为他做得非常出色。他的天赋、渴望、对比赛的热爱和激情是无庸置疑的。这是我一直喜欢伊桑的地方。我认为他打了一些精彩的比赛，他向所有人证明了他有能力在这里立足。
关于他是否希望伊桑本赛季留在俱乐部：我希望他留在这里，但从长远来看，对球员最好的是什么？伊桑需要踢上比赛，如果他留下，那是因为我们能保证他能获得这些出场时间。否则，我认为这对任何一方都不是好事。
关于对马丁·厄德高本赛季的期望：对他和布卡约（萨卡），我看到了不同的东西。显然他们去年遇到了一些问题，无法保持他们知道自己能带给球队的稳定性。所以那里有很大的提升空间和差距，我认为球队将从中受益，因为我看到了他们的渴望。
关于看到球员以超过1亿英镑的价格转会是否感到惊讶：是的，惊讶。说实话，我不会打赌这样的事。但这就是市场，这意味着有俱乐部愿意投资，或者他们认为这些球员的价值就是如此，这是合理的。最终，球员的价值就是有人愿意为你支付的价格，他们做到了，所以这就是价值，而且是合理的，因为有人乐意卖，有人乐意买，在中间，球员也乐意从一家俱乐部转会到另一家。所以我认为这很公平。
关于本赛季足球将如何演变：去年我们看到了巴黎圣日耳曼和拜仁慕尼黑之间的平局，这可能是我们从未见过的。所以让我们拭目以待。世界杯带来了一些非常不同的东西。我认为国际足球与英超相关的任何事物都非常不同，但我们会拭目以待。我相信会有惊喜，每个人都需要快速适应某些变化。我认为规则也会改变，当规则改变时，一切都变了，比赛也会演变。所以我们也会看到那里的变化。
关于他的球队是否会进化：当然有空间，以我们自己的球员来说。我认为提升我们现有的质量，提升个人表现，必须成为重点。如果我们因为任何原因无法做到，那么我们就必须考虑引援。
关于佩普·瓜迪奥拉离开曼城：我对他的赞扬可能还不够。首先是为英超、为国家，他开启了一种理解比赛的不同方式，我认为他将英超提升到了一个新的水平。他带来了我们从未见过的标准；我非常幸运能参与其中四年，理解并见证他是如何每天做到的。这非凡而独特，我以前总是说，我认为他是足球史上最好的教练，原因有很多。

他在许多不同的国家和联赛都做到了，但以一种真正一致和可持续的方式，这是最难做到的。我认为英超会想念他——我不知道我们作为教练是否会那么想念他！与他交手太难了，要与他以那种方式带领的球队竞争太难了。首先，我感谢与他共度的时光，那真是不可思议，然后因为我认为他提升了所有教练和球队以不同的方式工作，他让我们都变得更好了。和他在一起很愉快，现在轮到恩佐（马雷斯卡），他和他一样出色，因为我了解他。他会给俱乐部带来不同的东西，我祝他一切顺利。
关于他是否在宣布前知道瓜迪奥拉可能离开：百分之百不知道，但我有一些感觉和理解这可能发生。在过去一年里，你能感觉到可能发生这种情况，但像他这样的人，早上醒来可能会对周围看到的东西如此兴奋，并继续做下去——就像他十年来所做的那样，这在当今简直是不可思议。

关于在瓜迪奥拉仍在执教时赢得联赛有多特别：这显然是我职业生涯中面临的最大挑战之一，因为我知道标准。他们有幕后团队、稳定性和质量去再次做到这一点，所以这是一个真正的挑战，但正如我所说，我以一种方式看待它：无论发生什么，这都会让我们变得更好，并在俱乐部的各个部门不断突破界限，努力达到这个水平。当我来到这里时，我对我们落后的距离和年份有所了解，因为我在那里目睹了日常运作和赢得它的水平。我们在这么短的时间内做到了，我认为我们应该感到自豪。
关于马克斯·道曼本赛季的角色：他百分之百和我们在一起，这是肯定的——他参加了季前赛，他在我们体系中各方面都很好。他能踢多少时间就像其他人一样，他需要赢得这个机会。如果他赢得了，他就会上场；如果别人赢了，他就不会踢那么多。
关于迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利在队内的角色：这取决于球队的情况、他的训练和位置。我们有很多球员可以踢不同位置，这是我们阵容中的一大优势。
关于马雷斯卡接替瓜迪奥拉：我不知道细节，但我知道恩佐有性格，尤其是有知识在那里做出出色的工作。这就是他被选中的原因，因为他们可能选任何人，但他们选择了恩佐是出于正确的理由。他在各个层面都展示过了，当他进入欧冠时，他在切尔西所做的一切，现在在曼城。我相信他会做得很好。
关于他是否对球队的水平感到满意：我认为我们处于很好的位置，在做一些非常好的事情，而且我们仍在适应。我们离第一座奖杯还有几天，然后英超几天后就要开始，我认为我们没有妥协任何东西；我们非常自然地对待每一种情况，让球队达到最佳状态。

bodyEn: Georgia Stanway is settling in to life as a Gunner after taking part in our pre-season training camp in La Manga, and now you can submit your questions for our new midfielder through our Reddit Ask Me Anything (AMA).
We signed our no.4 from Bayern Munich this summer, bringing one of Europe's most decorated midfielders into our squad.

As well as her two European Championship successes with England, Georgia has won eight major titles with Bayern Munich and seven with Manchester City, including the 2016 Barclays Women's Super League.

Head to the official Arsenal Reddit channel to ask Georgia about her move to north London or any other topics that come to mind, then make sure to check back in on Wednesday, August 19 to see all of Georgia's answers!

bodyEn: Arsenal have opened talks with Bayer Leverkusen over a move for Jarell Quansah as they intensify efforts to bring in cover for William Saliba and Jurriën Timber.

The England defender, who left Liverpool last summer for an initial £30m and was part of Thomas Tuchel’s World Cup squad, has been identified as an ideal replacement for the France and Netherlands defenders, who will miss the start of the new season due to injury. While Quansah’s preferred position is in central defence, he was also deployed at right-back by Tuchel at the World Cup and was sent off in the last-16 victory over Mexico.

It is understood that Leverkusen are reluctant to sell the Warrington-born 23-year-old, who signed a five-year deal when he left Anfield last July, and would want at least €50m (£43m). Arsenal – who saw a bid of £30m for Aston Villa’s Ezri Konsa rejected earlier in the window – are not thought to want to pay that much but now could test the German club’s resolve by submitting a similar offer. Liverpool had a €70m buyback option on Quansah but that has now expired.
Arsenal are still believed to be interested in Konsa, who also filled in at right-back for England during the World Cup but is better known as a central defender. Villa value the 28-year-old at £60m.

Mikel Arteta said this week that Saliba’s back injury would take “some time to heal” and he was unsure about when he would be available again. Arsenal also have concerns over Timber, who pulled out of the Netherlands squad on the eve of the World Cup after failing to recover from a persistent groin injury that forced him to miss most of the run‑in last season.

“Jurriën is progressing really well,” Arteta said after Arsenal’s friendly defeat by Borussia ­Dortmund last Sunday. “He’s on the pitch, he’s doing quite a lot right now, but it’s still weeks away. I cannot tell you how much.”

Arsenal would still like to sign a new attacker before the end of the window and could allow Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus to depart in order to free up more funds. ­Galatasaray have offered £38m for Martinelli, although the Brazil ­forward has turned down a move to Turkey. Napoli have shown an ­interest in Jesus.
Ethan Nwaneri could also be sold, with Milan, Fulham, RB Leipzig and Borussia Dortmund among those who have been linked with the 19-year-old.

The future of Myles Lewis-Skelly is unclear after he was offered to Chelsea and Manchester United this week. Arteta refused to address the rumours after he scored in the friendly against Como – managed by Cesc Fábregas – on Wednesday.
“I’m not going to talk about speculation,” he said. “If there is speculation about our players, it’s a good sign. That means our players attract attention and are doing a good job.”

items.titleZh: 阿森纳就贾雷尔·宽萨的转会与勒沃库森展开谈判
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳与勒沃库森就宽萨转会展开谈判，对方要价至少5000万欧元，枪手仍有意孔萨。
bodyZh: 阿森纳已与勒沃库森就贾雷尔·宽萨的转会展开谈判，以加强为威廉·萨利巴和尤里安·廷贝尔寻找替补的努力。
这位英格兰后卫去年夏天以3000万英镑初始转会费离开利物浦，并入选了托马斯·图赫尔的世界杯大名单。他被视为因伤将缺席新赛季开局的法国和荷兰后卫的理想替代者。尽管宽萨的首选位置是中后卫，但图赫尔在世界杯上也让他出任右后卫，在16强战胜墨西哥的比赛中他还被红牌罚下。
据悉，勒沃库森不愿出售这位出生于沃灵顿的23岁球员，他在去年7月离开安菲尔德时签下了一份五年合同，德甲俱乐部希望至少得到5000万欧元（4300万英镑）。阿森纳在转会窗口早些时候为阿斯顿维拉的埃兹里·孔萨开出的3000万英镑报价已被拒绝，人们认为他们不想支付那么多，但现在可能会提交类似的报价来考验这家德国俱乐部的决心。利物浦曾拥有对宽萨的7000万欧元回购条款，但该条款现已过期。
据信阿森纳仍对孔萨感兴趣，他在世界杯期间也为英格兰队客串过右后卫，但更出名的是中后卫。维拉对这位28岁球员的估价为6000万英镑。
米克尔·阿尔特塔本周表示，萨利巴的背部伤病“需要一些时间才能痊愈”，他也不确定后者何时能再次上场。阿森纳也对廷贝尔感到担忧，他在世界杯前夕因腹股沟持续伤病未能恢复而退出荷兰队，上赛季他因此缺席了大部分收官阶段的比赛。
“尤里安恢复得很好，”阿尔特塔在上周日阿森纳友谊赛输给多特蒙德后表示。“他已经回到球场，目前做大量训练，但距离复出还有数周。我无法告诉你具体还要多久。”
阿森纳仍希望在转会窗口结束前签下一名新攻击手，并可能放走加布里埃尔·马丁内利和加布里埃尔·热苏斯以腾出更多资金。加拉塔萨雷已为马丁内利开出3800万英镑的报价，不过这位巴西前锋拒绝了前往土耳其的转会。那不勒斯对热苏斯表现出了兴趣。
伊桑·恩瓦内里也可能被出售，米兰、富勒姆、RB莱比锡和多特蒙德都与这位19岁小将传出绯闻。

items.titleEn: Jimmy Rimmer | 1948 - 2026
items.summaryEn: Everyone at the club is saddened to hear about the passing of our former goalkeeper, who played 146 games for us in the mid-1970s.
bodyEn: Everyone at the club is saddened to hear about the passing of our former goalkeeper Jimmy Rimmer.
Jimmy played 146 games for us and was crowned our Player of the Year in 1975 after succeeding the legendary Bob Wilson as our No. 1.

An unused substitute when Manchester United won the European Cup against Benfica in 1968, Jimmy ended nine years as an understudy to United's Alex Stepney to move to Highbury after impressing during a loan spell at Swansea.

Bertie Mee snapped up the shot-stopper in April 1974 for £40,000 and gave him his first-team debut against Liverpool shortly afterwards. Wilson announced his retirement at the end of that campaign and Rimmer became first choice, missing just three matches over the next three seasons, and won our Player of the Year award in 1975 and earned an England cap a year later.

Terry Neill's arrival as manager saw Pat Jennings follow him from Tottenham and Rimmer was duly sold to Aston Villa. He fared well there too and was first choice for six seasons, earning a First Division winners' medal in 1981 and helping Villa to glory in the 1982 European Cup and Super Cup. Rimmer later featured for Swansea City, Hamrum Spartans and Luton Town before retiring in 1986.
All our thoughts are with Jimmy's family and loved ones at this difficult time.

bodyZh: 俱乐部全体成员对前门将吉米·里默的逝世深感悲痛。
吉米为我们出战146场，在接替传奇人物鲍勃·威尔逊成为一号门将后，于1975年荣膺年度最佳球员。
1968年曼联击败本菲卡赢得欧洲冠军杯时，吉米是未上场的替补，在斯旺西租借期间表现出色后，结束了九年作为亚历克斯·斯特普尼替补的生涯，转会至海布里。
1974年4月，伯蒂·米以4万英镑签下这位门将，并很快让他完成了对阵利物浦的一线队首秀。威尔逊在那个赛季末宣布退役，里默成为首选门将，在接下来的三个赛季中仅缺席三场比赛，1975年赢得年度最佳球员奖，一年后获得英格兰国家队出场机会。
特里·尼尔出任主教练后，帕特·詹宁斯从热刺追随而来，里默随即被出售至阿斯顿维拉。他在那里同样表现出色，连续六个赛季担任首选门将，1981年获得顶级联赛冠军奖牌，并帮助维拉在1982年赢得欧洲冠军杯和欧洲超级杯。里默后来效力于斯旺西城、哈姆伦斯巴达和卢顿，于1986年退役。
在这个艰难的时刻，我们的心与吉米的家人和爱人同在。

items.titleEn: Quinn: Community Shield a chance to lay down marker
items.summaryEn: We chat with former Arsenal and Man City star Niall Quinn before the Community Shield
bodyEn: Niall Quinn cannot wait for Sunday's Community Shield in Cardiff and believes the winners will lay down a marker for the 2026/27 campaign.
Quinn spent a combined 13 years at Arsenal and Manchester City, so the former striker is the perfect candidate to give us a flavour of both sides ahead of this season's curtain-raiser.

We go into the match at the Principality Stadium as reigning Premier League champions, with City last season's FA Cup winners, and Quinn thinks this is the perfect matchup to kick off the new campaign.

"I think it's a historic game," Quinn said. "It's the first marker of the season, and it's a game that kind of sets the tone and asks the question, which champions are ready for the next year? Will it be the FA Cup champions or the Premier League champions? Who was in better shape?
"It’s a lovely game to be involved in, and it certainly whets the appetite for what's coming."
Quinn, who played in our 1989 curtain-raiser against Liverpool at Wembley, is looking forward to seeing us walk out in Cardiff as the defending league champions and urged us to kick on.

"Arsenal have managed to break through that really tough barrier of getting that title under their belt. They can kick on, take a deep breath and kick on and say, right, we can really up the game here and go further.
"I really commend Arsenal for coming to the party and doing what they did.

"It's been brilliant, winning the league, but it’s a new season, and it’s all about kicking on from here, and I’m sure Mikel will be saying that. I think that this lays the sort of marker down for how the season is going to go."
Manchester City will be under new management for the first time in a decade, as former Chelsea boss Enzo Maresca takes charge for the Cardiff showpiece after Pep Guardiola's reign came to an end.
How will Manchester City follow on from Guardiola? Quinn, who played almost 300 matches for the Manchester side, believes it's a tough act to follow.

He said: "Pep left his mark on the game. In every kid's game played at the grassroots level, with parents watching on the sidelines, Pep has influenced how the match is played and what the tactics are.

"He's had a huge influence, and then move it to actually the club itself and what happened under him at Manchester City. It's just a tidal wave of new thinking that really lifted Man City to a place that probably nobody could envisage it would go.

"So a new manager is coming in now to take on that, it's always the hardest thing ever to follow greatness. This is a really difficult task. It's going to be competitive and a big task for Maresca at Man City to maintain what Pep did, and I just hope that people understand, these things take time."
The pair last met in the Carabao Cup final in March 2026, which went the way of Manchester City, who prevailed 2-0 at Wembley.
A lot has changed since that final, and Quinn thinks we're a different side to the one that took to the field six months ago.
He said: "Obviously Man City will be a different team, but it's probably fair to say that Arsenal are a different team now, having got over the line and broken that barrier by winning the league.
"They’ve every right to feel like a great team, because they became a great team in May, when they got over the line. They became a great team.
"Now it's about where does that greatness go? We'll get the first glimpse of the joust against Man City. We'll get the first glimpse of it in Cardiff and I'm excited to see it unfold."

items.titleZh: 奎因：社区盾是树立标杆的机会
items.summaryZh: 前阿森纳和曼城球星奎因展望社区盾，认为胜者将为本赛季定调。
bodyZh: 尼尔·奎因迫不及待地期待周日在卡迪夫举行的社区盾比赛，他认为胜者将为2026/27赛季树立标杆。
奎因在阿森纳和曼城合计效力13年，这位前前锋是向我们介绍两队季前赛揭幕战的最佳人选。
我们作为卫冕英超冠军进入在公国体育场的比赛，而曼城是上赛季的足总杯冠军，奎因认为这是开启新赛季的完美对决。
“我认为这是一场历史性的比赛，”奎因说。“这是本赛季的第一个标杆，这场比赛定下基调并提出了问题：哪个冠军已经为新赛季做好准备？是足总杯冠军还是英超冠军？谁的状态更好？”
“这是一场令人愉悦的比赛，无疑会勾起人们对即将到来的赛事的胃口。”
奎因曾参加过我们1989年对阵利物浦的温布利揭幕战，他期待看到我们作为卫冕联赛冠军在卡迪夫亮相，并敦促我们继续前进。
“阿森纳已经成功突破了夺得联赛冠军的艰难壁垒。他们可以继续前进，深吸一口气，然后向前迈进，说：好吧，我们真的可以在这里提升比赛水平并走得更远。”
“我真心赞赏阿森纳的出色表现和成就。”
“赢得联赛冠军很棒，但这是新的赛季，关键在于从这里继续前进，我相信米克尔也会这么说。我认为这为本赛季的走势树立了标杆。”
曼城将迎来十年来首次新帅执教，前切尔西主帅恩佐·马雷斯卡将在佩普·瓜迪奥拉时代结束后执教卡迪夫这场重头戏。
曼城如何在瓜迪奥拉之后延续？为曼城出场近300次的奎因认为这很难效仿。
他说：“佩普在足球界留下了自己的印记。在基层每个孩子的比赛中，场边有家长观看，佩普影响了比赛的方式和战术。”
“他影响巨大，然后具体到俱乐部本身以及他在曼城所取得的成就。这是一股新思维浪潮，真正将曼城提升到了一个可能无人能预想的高度。”
“所以现在新教练来接任，这总是最难的事，即追随伟大。这是一项非常艰巨的任务。对马雷斯卡来说，在曼城保持佩普的成就是一件竞争激烈且艰巨的任务，我只希望人们能理解，这些都需要时间。”
两队上次交手是2026年3月的卡拉宝杯决赛，曼城在温布利以2-0获胜。
自那场决赛以来，很多事情发生了变化，奎因认为我们现在与六个月前那支球队不同了。
他说：“显然曼城会是一支不同的球队，但可以说阿森纳现在也是一支不同的球队，因为他们已经越过终点线，通过赢得联赛冠军打破了壁垒。”
“他们完全有权利感觉自己是一支伟大的球队，因为他们在五月越过终点线时成为了伟大的球队。他们成为了一支伟大的球队。”
“现在关键在于这种伟大将走向何方？我们将首次看到与曼城的较量。我们将在卡迪夫首次看到它，我很兴奋看到它如何展开。”

items.titleEn: New U18s Premier League season set to begin
items.summaryEn: Adam Birchall's under-18s get their 2026/27 campaign underway on Saturday
bodyEn: Adam Birchall's side will be looking to improve on their tenth-place finish from last season as a new U18s Premier League season begins this weekend.

The 29 Category One academy sides are split into north and south divisions, with 14 sides competing in the northern division and 15 in the southern. Every team faces every opponent once at home and once away over the course of the season, with the usual three points for a win and one for a draw.

At the end of the season, the team at the top of each division is crowned regional champions, before an overall final takes place between the two sides to determine the winner of the U18s Premier League.

Last season, Manchester City edged city rivals United to the northern title, while Chelsea stormed to success in the south. The Blues then came out on top against the Citizens in the league final, thrashing the five-time winners 5-1 at Stamford Bridge to get their hands on the trophy for the first time since 2018.

We amassed 33 points from our 28 league games last season, finishing tenth in the southern league table. We'll be aiming to improve on that total this season, starting with a trip to the West Midlands to face West Bromwich Albion this weekend.
Our fixture list includes London derbies with West Ham, Tottenham and champions Chelsea, before we finish the league season against Reading at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Saturday, May 9.
Should we win the division, a draw will take place to determine whether the final takes place at the home of the northern or southern champions, with a date for the contest confirmed after the draw.

29支第一类青训学院球队分为南北两个赛区，北区14支，南区15支。每队将在赛季中与同赛区所有对手进行主客场双循环比赛，胜一场得3分，平一场得1分。
赛季结束后，两个赛区积分最高的球队分别加冕区域冠军，随后两队进行终极决赛，决出U18英超联赛的总冠军。
上赛季，曼城在北部赛区险胜同城对手曼联，而切尔西则在南部赛区大获全胜。蓝军在联赛决赛中主场5-1横扫五冠王曼城，自2018年以来首次捧起奖杯。
上赛季我们在28场联赛中积33分，排名南部赛区第十。本赛季我们将力争取得更好成绩，本周末将首先前往西米德兰兹挑战西布罗姆维奇。
我们的赛程包括与西汉姆联、热刺和冠军切尔西的伦敦德比，联赛收官战将于5月9日周六在索巴房地产训练中心对阵雷丁。
若我们赢得赛区冠军，将通过抽签决定决赛在北部还是南部冠军的主场进行，抽签后确定比赛日期。

bodyEn: Curtis Jones’s future has been the subject of much gossipmongering this summer, especially with Inter plonking him in the middle of their radar. The Italian club have sniffed around the midfielder for quite a while and may ramp up their interest very soon with a bid of £30m to test Liverpool’s resolve.

Ipswich are not willing to stop their summer spending and a return for Julio Enciso looks nailed on. The Paraguay international had an injury-plagued loan spell at Portman Road in 2025 but is back to lead their battle for Premier League survival after a permanent deal was agreed with Strasbourg. Also making the move from the French club is right-back Abdoul Ouattara.

Crystal Palace have been knocked back by Monaco with a £35m bid for midfielder Lamine Camara. The Ligue 1 club are not particularly keen to sell him after getting a decent whack for Aladji Bamba, ensuring their finances are very healthy.

It may be the case that Arsenal need to sell a few players on, as is the case with Myles Lewis-Skelly. Another available player is Gabriel Martinelli who is attracting interest from Galatasaray. The Turkish giants are willing to splash a whopping £38m on the Brazilian. Gala are taking a keen look at Premier League players, with Liverpool’s Alexis Mac Allister another wanted.

After completing a deal for Lucas Herrington, Hull will bring in Joe Gelhardt from Leeds. The forward spent time on loan with the Tigers, helping them get promoted to the Premier League. Another inquiry has been made to Juventus over the availability of Teun Koopmeiners.

Aston Villa are priming themselves for a busy end to the window. João Palhinha has agreed to join on loan but Bayern Munich are eager to sell him. Jonathan David may also turn up in the West Midlands after the Villans got on the blower to Juventus.

Aaron Wan-Bissaka may not fancy a season in the second tier with West Ham. Thankfully for the DR Congo full-back Aston Villa and Fulham are both in for him at the moment, but Villa Park is the more likely destination. On the other side of the Hammers defence is El Hadji Malick Diouf. Sunderland have put a figure on him with a £40m bid but that is not enough for him to be allowed to head up to the Stadium of Light because his employers want £10m more.

Kyle Walker was a target for David Moyes a year ago and the Scot could offer him a route out of Burnley to Everton. The former England right-back has a year remaining on his contract but may fancy a season on Merseyside.

items.summaryZh: 今日传闻偏爱邦妮·泰勒版本， Curtis Jones 的未来成焦点。
bodyZh: 柯蒂斯·琼斯的未来今夏成为众多流言的主题，尤其是国际米兰将他列入重点引援目标。这家意大利俱乐部对这位中场球员觊觎已久，可能很快就会以3000万英镑的报价试探利物浦的决心，从而加大兴趣。
伊普斯维奇不愿停止今夏的引援步伐，胡利奥·恩西索的回归看似板上钉钉。这位巴拉圭国脚2025年在波特曼路球场的租借期饱受伤病困扰，但在与斯特拉斯堡达成永久转会后，他将回归带领球队为英超保级而战。同样从这家法国俱乐部加盟的还有右后卫阿卜杜勒·瓦塔拉。
水晶宫以3500万英镑报价摩纳哥中场拉明·卡马拉，但遭到拒绝。这家法甲俱乐部在出售阿莱吉·班巴后获得可观收入，财政状况良好，因此并不特别急于将他出售。
阿森纳可能需要出售一些球员，比如迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利。另一位可出售的球员是加布里埃尔·马丁内利，他引起了加拉塔萨雷的兴趣。这家土耳其豪门愿意为这位巴西人豪掷3800万英镑。加拉塔萨雷正在密切关注英超球员，利物浦的亚历克西斯·麦卡利斯特也是目标之一。
在完成卢卡斯·赫林顿的交易后，赫尔城将从利兹联引进乔·格尔哈特。这位前锋曾租借效力于老虎队，帮助球队升入英超。此外，他们还就特恩·科普梅纳斯的可用性向尤文图斯进行了询问。
阿斯顿维拉正为转会窗结束前的忙碌做准备。若昂·帕利尼亚已同意租借加盟，但拜仁慕尼黑渴望将他出售。乔纳森·戴维也可能出现在西米德兰兹，因为维拉已经联系了尤文图斯。
阿隆·万-比萨卡可能不愿随西汉姆联征战英冠赛季。对这位刚果民主共和国边后卫来说，幸运的是阿斯顿维拉和富勒姆目前都在追求他，但维拉公园是更可能的目的地。西汉姆防线另一侧的目标是埃尔·哈吉·马利克·迪乌夫。桑德兰已报价4000万英镑求购他，但这不足以让他加盟光明球场，因为其东家想要再多1000万英镑。
凯尔·沃克一年前曾是戴维·莫耶斯的目标，这位苏格兰教练可能为他提供离开伯恩利转投埃弗顿的出路。这位前英格兰右后卫的合同还剩一年，但他可能愿意在默西塞德度过一个赛季。

bodyEn: Myles Lewis-Skelly has been offered to Manchester United as a potential left-back option, with Arsenal wishing to recoup some of the £75m paid to Newcastle for Bruno Guimarães.

Chelsea, it is understood, have also been made aware of the 19-year-old’s availability. Lewis-Skelly won the Premier League under Mikel Arteta last term, but whether the west London club will make a move for him is unclear.

Lewis-Skelly, who made only five league starts and 36 appearances in all competitions in 2025-26, signed a five-year contract last summer. His prospective price is thought to be in the region of £45m.

This is within the range of finance United have spent so far this summer, after Youri Tielemans’s £35m move from Aston Villa and Andrey Santos’s arrival for £48m plus £2m of add-ons from Chelsea. United are now weighing up a move for the teenager.

Newcastle’s Lewis Hall remains of prime interest for United but, after losing Guimarães, Sandro Tonali to Tottenham, and Anthony Gordon to Barcelona, the new Newcastle manager, Matthias Jaissle, is intent the 21-year-old England international does not also depart
RB Leipzig’s 28-year-old left-back David Raum is another in the position United may assess.

Chelsea have already had a busy summer in the market, having spent over £300m on a raft of new signings. Maxence Lacroix and Marco Palestra have been brought in to bolster the centre and right of the defence respectively, while Morgan Rogers became the club’s record signing at a cost of £117m.

But Xabi Alonso’s side have a hole on the left of their defence after Marc Cucurella’s £52m move to Real Madrid. The 20-year-old Jorrel Hato, who featured for the Netherlands at the World Cup, was Cucurella’s deputy at left-back.
Mason Mount missed training on Monday and Tuesday at United’s County Kildare summer training camp owing to a knock he received on a foot in Saturday’s 1-1 draw with Paris Saint-Germain in Gothenburg.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳将刘易斯-斯凯利推荐给曼联，切尔西也已得知球员可售；纽卡后卫霍尔仍是曼联首选。
bodyZh: 迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利已被推荐给曼联，作为左后卫的潜在人选，阿森纳希望收回支付给纽卡斯尔引进布鲁诺·吉马良斯的部分7500万英镑费用。
据了解，切尔西也已得知这位19岁小将可以转会。刘易斯-斯凯利上赛季在米克尔·阿尔特塔麾下赢得了英超冠军，但这支西伦敦球队是否会求购他尚不清楚。
刘易斯-斯凯利在2025-26赛季仅获得5次联赛首发，各项赛事出场36次，去年夏天签下了一份五年合同。他的预计转会费在4500万英镑左右。
这一价格在曼联今夏迄今为止的投入范围内，此前曼联以3500万英镑签下尤里·蒂莱曼斯，并以4800万英镑加200万英镑附加条款从切尔西引进安德烈·桑托斯。曼联目前正在考虑求购这位小将。
纽卡斯尔的刘易斯·霍尔仍是曼联的首要目标，但在失去吉马良斯、桑德罗·托纳利（转会热刺）和安东尼·戈登（转会巴萨）后，纽卡新帅马蒂亚斯·雅伊斯勒决心不让这位21岁的英格兰国脚也离开。
RB莱比锡的28岁左后卫大卫·劳姆是曼联可能评估的另一个目标。
切尔西在转会市场上已经度过了一个繁忙的夏天，已花费超过3亿英镑签下多名新援。马克桑斯·拉克鲁瓦和马可·帕莱斯特拉分别被引进以加强中卫和右后卫位置，而摩根·罗杰斯以1.17亿英镑成为俱乐部历史标王。
但在马克·库库雷利亚以5200万英镑转会皇马后，哈维·阿隆索的球队在左后卫位置出现空缺。20岁的约雷尔·哈托曾在世界杯上代表荷兰队出场，是库库雷利亚在左后卫位置上的替补。
梅森·芒特因在周六哥德堡1-1战平巴黎圣日耳曼的比赛中脚部受伤，缺席了曼联在基尔代尔郡夏季训练营周一和周二的训练。

Saliba will be out for an extended period after breaking down during the World Cup with a back injury.After Arsenal lost a second successive friendly when Borussia Dortmund won 3-2 on Sunday to lift the Emirates Cup in a performance that featured several defensive mistakes, Arteta would not be drawn on when the France defender is expected to return, but said it would take “some time to heal”. bodyEn: Arsenal are stepping up their efforts to sign defensive cover for William Saliba after Mikel Arteta revealed that Jurriën Timber is well away from returning to competitive action. Saliba will be out for an extended period after breaking down during the World Cup with a back injury.

After Arsenal lost a second successive friendly when Borussia Dortmund won 3-2 on Sunday to lift the Emirates Cup in a performance that featured several defensive mistakes, Arteta would not be drawn on when the France defender is expected to return, but said it would take “some time to heal”.

There are also concerns over Timber, who pulled out of the Netherlands squad on the eve of the World Cup after failing to recover from a persistent groin injury that forced him to miss most of the run‑in last season.
“Jurriën is progressing really well,” Arteta said. “He’s on the pitch, he’s doing quite a lot right now, but it’s still weeks away. I cannot tell you how much.
“William Saliba is in rest mode at the moment for two weeks. He had to do almost nothing, an aggravated injury, so it’s going to take some time to heal.”

Pressed on how Arsenal will cope without Saliba, he said: “We have experienced that in the past, unfortunately. When he’s been available, he’s hit home and the stats are incredible. We know we lost a massive player, the same with Jurriën.”

Arsenal have had a bid for Aston Villa’s Ezri Konsa rejected and are expected to return with a new offer for the England centre-back, who is also capable of playing at right-back. Villa value him at £60m, but with less than two years left on his contract Arsenal are unwilling to pay that much for the 28‑year‑old.

The Premier League champions have also shown an interest in signing Cristian Romero from Tottenham, but any move for the Argentina defender is extremely unlikely given Spurs’ reluctance to sell to their north London rivals.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳加快补强防线，廷贝尔与萨利巴缺阵
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳加速补强防线，预计再报价孔萨；阿尔特塔称现有球员需提升，廷贝尔远未复出，萨利巴伤停。
bodyZh: 在米克尔·阿尔特塔透露尤里恩·廷贝尔距离复出参赛还很遥远之后，阿森纳正在加大力度为威廉·萨利巴引进防守替补。萨利巴在世界杯期间背部受伤，将长时间缺阵。
周日，阿森纳在一场友谊赛中再次失利，多特蒙德以3-2获胜并捧起酋长杯，比赛中阿森纳出现多次防守失误。阿尔特塔不愿透露这位法国后卫预计何时回归，但表示需要“一段时间来恢复”。
廷贝尔也令人担忧，他在世界杯前夕因未能从持续的腹股沟伤势中恢复而退出荷兰队，这一伤势使他缺席了上赛季大部分尾声比赛。
“尤里恩恢复得非常好，”阿尔特塔说。“他已经在球场上了，目前做很多事情，但还差几个星期。我不能告诉你具体多久。”
“威廉·萨利巴目前处于休息状态，为期两周。他几乎不能做任何事，因为伤势加重，所以需要一些时间恢复。”
当被问及阿森纳如何在缺少萨利巴的情况下应对时，他说：“不幸的是，我们过去也经历过这种情况。当他可以上场时，他的表现非常出色，数据令人难以置信。我们知道我们失去了一名重要球员，廷贝尔也是如此。”
阿森纳对阿斯顿维拉的埃兹里·孔萨提出的报价已被拒绝，预计他们将向这位英格兰中卫提出新的报价，孔萨也能胜任右后卫。维拉对他的估价为6000万英镑，但鉴于其合同剩余不到两年，阿森纳不愿为这位28岁的球员支付如此高的价格。
英超冠军也对从托特纳姆热刺签下克里斯蒂安·罗梅罗表现出兴趣，但鉴于热刺不愿出售给北伦敦对手，任何引进这位阿根廷后卫的举动都极不可能。

items.titleEn: Premier League 2026-27 preview No 1: Arsenal
items.summaryEn: With most of their rivals changing managers, can the champions go back-to-back for the first time in more than 90 years?Guardian writers’ predicted position: 1st (NB: this is not necessarily Ed Aarons’ prediction but the average of our writers’ tips)Last season’s position: 1st Continue reading...
bodyEn: Guardian writers’ predicted position: 1st (NB: this is not necessarily Ed Aarons’ prediction but the average of our writers’ tips)
Last season’s position: 1st

Even losing on penalties in the Champions League final could not take any of the gloss off last season as Arsenal ended their 22-year wait to be crowned Premier League champions. The celebrations have continued all summer after some wild scenes on the streets of north London on their return from Budapest, although concerns over the fitness of some key players after their exploits at the World Cup are mounting.

Arsenal have acted quickly to reinforce their midfield by signing Bruno Guimarães from Newcastle given Declan Rice’s workload must be managed very carefully after playing through neural pain in his hamstring and lower back since December. The arrival of Greece forward Christos Tzolis to replace Leandro Trossard also looks like a smart piece of business on the left-hand side of the attack. But with Vinícius Junior staying at Real Madrid, despite Arsenal’s best efforts, supporters will be hoping there is still a chance that the sporting director, Andrea Berta, could conjure up a heavyweight attacking signing before the window closes given Bukayo Saka’s fitness problems in recent seasons.

The back injury that will sideline William Saliba for an unknown period could prove even more central to Arsenal’s hopes of retaining their title. A defence that conceded 27 goals last year in the Premier League may struggle without the immense talents of the France defender, even if they can bring in Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa as hoped. Whether Arsenal can maintain their dominance from set pieces over the past two campaigns will also be crucial, with more scrutiny expected from video assistant referees after the fallout from their controversial victory at West Ham in May.

Not since 1935, when Arsenal became the second team to win three successive league titles, have they retained their crown. Having strengthened the deepest squad in the division still further, they will take some stopping again.

Money definitely isn’t an issue for Stan Kroenke. Arsenal’s co-owner became America’s largest private landowner this year and has spent more than £1.5bn on new players since becoming the majority shareholder in 2011 through his holding company, Kroenke Sports & Entertainment (KSE). Next on the agenda is an upgrade to the Emirates Stadium that could increase the capacity of their home to more than 70,000. Talks have begun with the stadium’s original architects, Populous, over a project that could cost up to £500m. The much-criticised shirtsleeve deal with Visit Rwanda ended last season and has been replaced by the HR company Deel, itself controversial in some sections of the Arsenal fanbase, while Emirates have renewed their longstanding partnership until 2033.

Kroenke and his son Josh – who are co-chairs – clearly revelled in carrying out the Premier League trophy at Selhurst Park before it was presented to the captain, Martin Ødegaard, after Arsenal’s final game of the season in May. Having once been criticised for running the club “like an investment vehicle”, now they are praised for the enormous effect they have made. Kroenke Jr’s promise there would be “no standing still once this season ends” was an ominous sign to their rivals given KSE have a reputation as serial winners in a number of sports in America.

Mikel Arteta’s expected bumper new contract extension – that will make him one of the best-paid managers in the world – has yet to be confirmed, but there is no doubting his commitment to the cause. The Spaniard could not bear to watch as Manchester City’s challenge collapsed against Bournemouth last season and was in his back garden “building a fire” when Arsenal were confirmed as champions. With Pep Guardiola gone, Arteta has the opportunity to build a new winning dynasty of his own.

The arrival of Guimarães was another big statement of intent from Arsenal. The former Newcastle captain wants to win more trophies after capturing hearts and minds on Tyneside and he will provide several options in the already well-stacked engine room. As well as relieving the load on Rice, the versatile 28-year-old Brazil midfielder is capable of fulfilling a number of roles, from deep-lying playmaker to box-to box destroyer. While it remains to be seen how Arteta chooses to use Guimarães when he also has Martín Zubimendi, Myles Lewis-Skelly, Ødegaard and Mikel Merino at his disposal, his talents will only add to the quality in Arsenal’s squad.

Referees have been told to pay much more attention to grappling during set-pieces this season so it will be interesting to see if this has any effect on Arsenal. Only three teams in the Premier League had a better non-penalty expected goal difference than the Gunners had from set plays alone.

Max Dowman was a record-breaking revelation as he dipped his toes into senior football for the first time last season and the signs are that the 16-year-old could be handed more opportunities after impressing again during pre-season. A brilliant goal and an assist against Girona capped a man-of-the-match display from the right flank. With Saka and Noni Madueke to be eased back in after returning from World Cup duty, Dowman is ready to add to his solitary Premier League start, against Crystal Palace on the final day of last season, and should appear more regularly in cup competitions.

Rice and Saka arrived in the United States feeling the effects of a marathon season and it was to their immense credit that they played through the pain barrier and made it to England’s eighth match of the tournament. Only Thomas Tuchel knows why he left Saka on the bench in the semi-final against Argentina and his hat-trick in the third-place playoff a few days later showed how potent he can be even with an achilles problem. Both require an extended break before returning to the rigours of club football and Arsenal will give them as long as possible. But such is their importance that it will be sooner rather than later.

items.titleZh: 英超2026-27赛季前瞻（一）：阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 大多数对手换帅，阿森纳能否成为1935年以来首支卫冕英超的球队？《卫报》记者预测首位。
bodyZh: 《卫报》记者预测排名：第1位（注：这不一定是埃德·阿伦斯的预测，而是我们记者建议的平均值）
上赛季排名：第1位
尽管在欧冠决赛中点球失利，但这并未给上赛季的阿森纳蒙上阴影，因为他们结束了22年的等待，加冕英超冠军。从布达佩斯归来后，北伦敦街头出现了狂野的庆祝场面，整个夏天庆祝活动持续不断，不过一些关键球员在世界杯上的征战后的身体状况令人担忧。

阿森纳迅速行动，从纽卡斯尔签下布鲁诺·吉马良斯以加强中场，因为德克兰·赖斯自12月以来一直带着腿筋和下背部的神经疼痛出战，他的负荷必须得到非常谨慎的管理。希腊前锋克里斯托斯·佐利斯的到来，以取代莱安德罗·特罗萨德，看起来也是进攻左路的一笔精明操作。但尽管阿森纳尽了最大努力，维尼修斯·儒尼奥尔仍留在皇家马德里，球迷们仍希望体育总监安德里亚·贝尔塔有机会在转会窗口关闭前变出一笔重量级攻击线签约，因为布卡约·萨卡近几个赛季都存在伤病问题。
威廉·萨利巴的背伤将使他缺席一段时间，具体时长未知，这可能对阿森纳卫冕的希望更为关键。上赛季英超联赛中丢球27个的防线，如果没有这位法国后卫的巨大才能，可能会陷入困境，即使他们能如愿从阿斯顿维拉引进埃兹里·孔萨。阿森纳能否保持过去两个赛季在定位球上的统治力也至关重要，在五月客场击败西汉姆联的争议胜利引发风波后，视频助理裁判预计将进行更多审查。
自1935年阿森纳成为第二支赢得三连冠的球队以来，他们还从未成功卫冕过。在进一步加强了联赛中最深厚的阵容后，他们再次势不可挡。

对于斯坦·克伦克来说，金钱绝对不是问题。阿森纳的联合所有者今年成为美国最大的私人土地所有者，自2011年通过其控股公司克伦克体育娱乐公司（KSE）成为大股东以来，他已在新球员身上花费超过15亿英镑。接下来的议程是升级酋长球场，可能将主场容量增加到7万人以上。已与球场的原始建筑师Populous就一项可能耗资高达5亿英镑的项目展开谈判。备受批评的与卢旺达旅游的衣袖赞助合同在上赛季结束，取而代之的是人力资源公司Deel，这本身在阿森纳部分球迷群体中就存在争议，而阿联酋航空已将长期合作续约至2033年。
克伦克和他的儿子乔什——两人同为联合主席——在五月阿森纳本赛季最后一场比赛结束后，在塞尔赫斯特公园举起英超奖杯并将其交给队长马丁·厄德高之前，显然非常享受这一时刻。他们曾因“像投资工具一样经营俱乐部”而受到批评，如今却因其产生的巨大影响而受到称赞。小克伦克承诺“本赛季结束后不会停滞不前”，考虑到KSE在美国多项运动中以连续获胜著称，这对他们的对手来说是一个不祥的预兆。
米克尔·阿尔特塔预计将获得丰厚的新合同续约——这将使他成为世界上薪酬最高的主教练之一——但尚未得到确认，但他对事业的奉献毋庸置疑。上赛季，当曼城在伯恩茅斯面前崩溃时，这位西班牙人不敢观看，而当阿森纳确认夺冠时，他正在后花园“生火”。随着佩普·瓜迪奥拉的离去，阿尔特塔有机会建立自己的新王朝。
吉马良斯的到来是阿森纳的又一重大意向声明。这位前纽卡斯尔队长在泰恩赛德俘获了人心，之后他希望赢得更多奖杯，他将为已经储备充足的中场提供多种选择。除了减轻赖斯的负担，这位全能型28岁巴西中场能够胜任多种角色，从拖后组织核心到B2B中场破坏者。尽管阿尔特塔在拥有马丁·苏比门迪、迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利、厄德高和米克尔·梅里诺的情况下，如何选择使用吉马良斯还有待观察，但他的天赋只会增加阿森纳阵容的质量。
本赛季裁判已被指示在定位球时更加注意拉拽动作，因此看看这是否会对阿森纳产生影响将很有趣。在英超中，只有三支球队的非点球预期进球差高于阿森纳仅凭定位球的表现。
马克斯·道曼上赛季首次踏入成年足球领域，是一个破纪录的惊喜，迹象表明，这位16岁的小将在季前赛再次表现出色后，可能会得到更多机会。对阵赫罗纳时，他打入一粒精彩进球并送出一次助攻，完成了右路的最佳球员表现。由于萨卡和诺尼·马杜埃凯在世界杯归队后需要逐步恢复，道曼已准备好增加自己的英超首发次数——他上赛季最后一天对阵水晶宫时曾有过一次首发——并且应该更频繁地出现在杯赛中。
赖斯和萨卡抵达美国时感受到了漫长赛季的影响，但他们带伤作战并坚持到了英格兰队的第八场比赛，这值得高度赞扬。只有托马斯·图赫尔知道为什么他在半决赛对阿根廷的比赛中将萨卡放在替补席上，而几天后他却在季军赛中上演帽子戏法，展示了即使有跟腱问题，他依然火力十足。两人在回归艰苦的俱乐部足球之前都需要一段较长的休息时间，阿森纳会尽可能地给他们时间。但他们实在太重要了，所以回归会比预想的更快。

bodyEn: The Arsenal manager, Mikel Arteta, has backed “warrior” Bruno Guimarães to “ignite something different” in the Premier League champions. The Brazil midfielder was introduced to fans ahead of Sunday’s 3-2 defeat by Borussia Dortmund in the Emirates Cup after completing his £75m move from Newcastle.
The 28-year-old, who has signed a four-year deal, bolsters a midfield which already includes Declan Rice, Martin Ødegaard, Mikel Merino, Martín Zubimendi and Eberechi Eze.

“You can see the immediate reaction,” Arteta told the club website after Guimarães was given a warm reception by supporters. “I think he describes himself as a warrior. I think he’s a warrior with a tremendous quality as well, and intuition and leadership and charisma that is going to help us. That is going to really ignite something different in the team. I think he’s going to push everybody inside the team as well and that’s the type of player that we need.”

After finishing runners-up for three successive seasons, Arsenal ended their 22-year wait for the Premier League title last term, in addition to reaching the Champions League and Carabao Cup finals. Guimarães watched on against Dortmund as an Ethan Nwaneri strike and a Viktor Gyökeres penalty were not enough to prevent defeat.
Samuele Inácio, Konstantinos Karetsas and Joane Gadou scored for the Bundesliga side at the Emirates Stadium, before Arsenal won a pre-arranged penalty shootout 5-4.

“Disappointed that we lost the game,” said Arteta, who gave Ødegaard his first minutes of pre-season following the World Cup and will welcome back his full squad on Monday. “I think there were some poor moments where we were not very recognisable, especially in set-pieces and defending actions and timings that we are normally very efficient [in].

“Some other very, very positive attacking combinations, big chances that didn’t finish in anything because of the final pass because they were completely open. But, overall, disappointed because you want to win the games in any context and today, we haven’t managed to do that.”

The Manchester City manager, Enzo Maresca, praised the impact of his wide players after Antoine Semenyo supplied ⁠assists for Omar Marmoush in a 3-1 victory over Atlético Madrid to wrap up their preseason tour ⁠of Asia.

Marmoush scored ⁠twice in ​the space of three minutes early in the second half before substitute Rayan Aït-Nouri added a third in stoppage ⁠time, helping City overturn a half-time deficit in front of more than 50,000 fans at Seoul World Cup Stadium.

items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔称吉马良斯为战士，相信他能点燃球队新火花。
bodyZh: 阿森纳主教练米克尔·阿尔特塔支持“战士”布鲁诺·吉马良斯在英超冠军球队中“点燃不同的东西”。这位巴西中场在完成从纽卡斯尔转会而来的7500万英镑交易后，于周日酋长杯3-2负于多特蒙德的比赛前被介绍给球迷。
这位28岁的球员签下了一份为期四年的合同，增强了本已拥有德克兰·赖斯、马丁·厄德高、米克尔·梅里诺、马丁·苏比门迪和埃贝雷奇·埃泽的中场阵容。
“你可以看到即时的反应，”阿尔特塔在吉马良斯受到球迷热烈欢迎后告诉俱乐部网站。“我认为他把自己描述为一名战士。我认为他是一名拥有出色技术、直觉、领导力和魅力的战士，这将帮助我们。这真的会在球队中点燃不同的东西。我认为他也会推动队内每个人，这就是我们需要的那种球员。”
在连续三个赛季获得亚军后，阿森纳在上赛季结束了长达22年的英超冠军等待，此外还打进了欧冠和联赛杯决赛。吉马良斯在对阵多特蒙德的比赛中目睹了伊桑·恩瓦内里的进球和维克托·约克雷斯的点球不足以阻止失败。
萨穆埃尔·伊纳西奥、康斯坦丁诺斯·卡雷察斯和乔恩·加杜为德甲球队在酋长球场进球，随后阿森纳在预先安排的点球大战中以5-4获胜。
“很失望我们输掉了比赛，”阿尔特塔说，他给了厄德高世界杯后季前赛的首秀机会，并将于周一迎回完整阵容。“我认为有一些糟糕的时刻，我们不太像自己，尤其是在定位球、防守动作和时间安排上，这些通常是我们非常高效的方面。”
“还有一些非常非常积极的进攻组合，创造了巨大机会，但因为最后一传而一无所获，因为他们完全开放。但总的来说，很失望，因为你希望在任何情况下都赢球，而今天我们没有做到。”
曼城主教练恩佐·马雷斯卡赞扬了他的边锋球员在3-1战胜马德里竞技的比赛中产生的影响，安托万·塞梅尼奥为奥马尔·马尔穆什提供了助攻，结束了他们的亚洲季前巡回赛。
马尔穆什在下半场初段三分钟内梅开二度，随后替补出场的拉扬·艾特-努里在补时阶段再入一球，帮助曼城在首尔世界杯体育场超过5万名球迷面前逆转了半场落后的局面。

“总的来说，这是对阵欧洲最好球队之一的非常优秀的测试，”马雷斯卡说。“球员们的努力值得称赞。从明天开始，季前赛结束，真正的挑战开始。”

“我们需要临门一脚。这是我们需要改进的地方，”他说。“我们正在慢慢做到这一点，有埃尔林（哈兰德）我们会更具威胁。今天奥马尔进了两球。这是一种鼓舞。”

bodyEn: If there was one of his many assets Newcastle supporters grew to love above all about Bruno Guimarães then it was best summed up by the man himself after being unveiled as Arsenal’s new £75m signing. “That’s a tough one,” said the Brazil midfielder when asked what fans in north London can expect from him. “I would say I can pass the ball, run a lot and play like a warrior. I’ll never give up.”

After more than four years on Tyneside and having seen Alexander Isak, Anthony Gordon and Sandro Tonali precede Eddie Howe’s departure, Guimarães – who was devastated after missing a penalty for the Seleção in their defeat against Norway in the last 16 of the World Cup – was determined to seize his opportunity.

While his emotional statement released by Newcastle as his move to Arsenal was confirmed on Saturday said they “did everything they could to keep me”, at the age of 28 he clearly felt it may never come again.

Andrea Berta’s pursuit of Vinícius Júnior came up short this week after the Brazil forward signed an improved six-year deal with Real Madrid. But at least Arsenal’s sporting director was finally able to bring in a player who was first courted by the club in the early days of Mikel Arteta’s reign, and who will add to the outstanding crop of central midfielders at his disposal.

Edu Gaspar, Berta’s predecessor, is understood to have first enquired about Guimarães when he was still at Athletico Paranaense in Brazil before he joined Lyon in the January 2020 transfer window – a few weeks after Arteta’s arrival at the Emirates.

They were also interested when Newcastle won the race to sign him in January 2022 for €40m, which came back to haunt Arsenal when he scored in a 2-0 win that went a long way to them missing out on Champions League qualification that season.

That first of nine appearances is the only time he scored against Arsenal, but Guimarães always impressed in a variety of roles whenever he came up against them, including in the Carabao Cup semi-final Newcastle won 4-0 on aggregate in 2025. He has covered more distance, won more duels and committed more fouls against Arsenal than any other side since making his Premier League debut.

It was no surprise that Declan Rice – the only player in the division to have covered more distance than Guimarães in that period and who enjoyed their fair share of battles – was one of the first to welcome him to Arsenal with a message that said “come here and please no more fights, now we’re friends”.

It is hard to argue with Guimarães that Arsenal have “one of the best midfields” in Europe because last season proved it. Yet having gone all the way to the Champions League final before spending the summer with England, after suffering with neural pain in his hamstring and lower back since December, Rice must be treated with the utmost care in the coming months. Guimarães can provide cover for him in a box-to-box role and gives Arteta options to rotate his other midfielders more frequently.

He did not seem to trust Christian Nørgaard, who has joined Everton, to deputise for Martín Zubimendi in the Premier League last year, and that led to the Spain midfielder running out of steam in the spring.

It was telling that the teenager Myles Lewis-Skelly started in his preferred position at the base of midfield during the title run-in, and against Paris Saint-Germain in Budapest for the Champions League final, having begun the campaign as a left-back. Guimarães showed at Newcastle he is capable of playing in a deeper role as well and Arteta must decide how to balance his plethora of options in a crucial part of the pitch.

While he could not match Mikel Merino’s goalscoring exploits for Spain,Martin Ødegaard showed signs that he is back to his best during the World Cup after another disappointing season for Arsenal that was again interrupted by injury.

Having missed out on Morgan Rogers, the onus will be on the Norway captain, Guimarães and last summer’s big signing, Eberechi Eze, to provide some creativity to an attack that struggled to break down the low block at times last season.

Arsenal are still in the market for a defender to cover the absence of William Saliba for an extended period, while they would like to bring in another forward to add to the signing of Christos Tzolis. Atlético Madrid’s Julián Alvarez or Bradley Barcola of Paris Saint-Germain would fit the bill, although it remains to be seen if they will bring in a marquee player without offloading Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus – who has interest from Napoli. Even if they do depart, the presence of another familiar face in the Brazil centre-back Gabriel should also help Guimarães settle into his new home.

“Big Gabi was very excited,” he told Arsenal’s website. “Every time he sent me the message: ‘We’ll wait for you, when will you come?’ I’m so excited to join them, not only the Brazilians, we have an amazing squad here. I’m so excited to meet the other players, to start training. I just want to give my best.”

items.summaryZh: 吉马良斯既能胜任更深位置，也需为攻坚低防守的锋线提供创造力。数据显示这笔交易或为定位球又一妙手。
bodyZh: 如果纽卡斯尔球迷最喜爱布鲁诺·吉马良斯的众多特质中有一项最为突出，那最好由他本人来总结——在他正式亮相为阿森纳7500万英镑新援之后。“这是个难题，”当被问到北伦敦球迷能对他有何期待时，这位巴西中场说道。“我会说我能传球、跑动很多，并且像战士一样战斗。我永远不会放弃。”
在泰恩赛德度过四年多，目睹亚历山大·伊萨克、安东尼·戈登和桑德罗·托纳利在埃迪·豪离队前相继离开后，吉马良斯——在世界杯16强赛巴西负于挪威时罚失点球而备受打击——决心抓住机会。
尽管纽卡斯尔在上周六确认他转会阿森纳时发布的动情声明称他们“为留下我做了一切”，但在28岁的年纪，他显然觉得这样的机会可能不会再有了。
安德烈亚·贝尔塔追逐维尼修斯·儒尼奥尔本周落空，这位巴西前锋与皇马签下了一份为期六年的改进合同。但至少阿森纳体育总监终于能够引进一名在米克尔·阿尔特塔执教初期就被俱乐部追求的球员，他将为阿尔特塔手中出众的中场球员储备增添力量。
据悉，贝尔塔的前任埃杜·加斯帕尔最早在吉马良斯还在巴西的巴拉纳竞技时就曾询价过他，随后他在2020年1月转会窗加入里昂——那是在阿尔特塔抵达酋长球场几周之后。
当纽卡斯尔在2022年1月以4000万欧元赢得签下他的竞争时，阿森纳也曾有意。这最终让阿森纳后悔不已，因为他在一场2-0的胜利中进球，那场胜利很大程度上导致枪手那个赛季无缘欧冠资格。
他在对阵阿森纳的首次（也是唯一一次）进球出现在九次交锋中的第一场，但吉马良斯每次与阿森纳交手时都在不同角色中给人留下深刻印象，包括2025年纽卡斯尔以4-0总比分赢得的联赛杯半决赛。自他英超首秀以来，他对阵阿森纳时的跑动距离、赢得对抗次数和犯规次数都超过对阵其他任何球队。
毫无疑问，德克兰·赖斯——英超中唯一一位在该时期跑动距离超过吉马良斯的球员，并且两人有过不少交锋——是最早欢迎他加盟阿森纳的人之一，他发消息说：“来这里吧，请不要再打架了，现在我们已经是朋友了。”
很难反驳吉马良斯所说阿森纳拥有欧洲“最佳中场之一”的论断，因为上赛季证明了这一点。然而，赖斯一路踢到欧冠决赛，随后整个夏天随英格兰队度过，自12月以来一直饱受腿筋和下背部的神经疼痛困扰，未来几个月必须以最大限度的谨慎对待他。吉马良斯可以在B2B角色中为他提供掩护，并让阿尔特塔有更多轮换其他中场球员的选择。
上赛季他似乎并不信任已加盟埃弗顿的克里斯蒂安·诺尔高来为马丁·苏比门迪担任替补，这导致这位西班牙中场在春季体能透支。

值得注意的一点是，小将迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利在争冠冲刺阶段以及布达佩斯对阵巴黎圣日耳曼的欧冠决赛中，都在他偏爱的中场底部位置首发——尽管他赛季初是作为左后卫出场的。吉马良斯在纽卡斯尔证明了他也能胜任更深的位置，阿尔特塔必须决定如何在这一关键区域平衡他的众多选择。
尽管他无法与米克尔·梅里诺在西班牙队的进球表现相提并论，但在又一个因伤病中断的令人失望的阿森纳赛季之后，马丁·厄德高在世界杯期间显示出他正在回归最佳状态的迹象。
在错失摩根·罗杰斯之后，压力落在了挪威队长、吉马良斯以及去年夏天的大手笔引援埃贝雷奇·埃泽身上，他们需要为上赛季有时难以攻破低位防线的进攻提供创造力。

阿森纳仍在转会市场上寻找一名后卫以覆盖威廉·萨利巴长期缺阵的情况，同时他们希望再引进一名前锋，作为签下克里斯托斯·佐利斯的补充。马德里竞技的胡利安·阿尔瓦雷斯或巴黎圣日耳曼的布拉德利·巴尔科拉都符合要求，不过在没有出售加布里埃尔·马丁内利和加布里埃尔·热苏斯（那不勒斯对他有意）的情况下是否会引进一名顶级球星，仍有待观察。即使他们离开，另一张熟悉面孔——巴西中卫加布里埃尔的存在也应该有助于吉马良斯融入新家。
“大加比非常兴奋，”他告诉阿森纳官网。“每次他给我发消息：‘我们等你，你什么时候来？’我很高兴加入他们，不仅仅是巴西人，我们这里有一支很棒的球队。我很期待见到其他球员，开始训练。我只想全力以赴。”
